6736        // The scan below reads packfiles directly, so any records still
6737        // sitting in a shard's append buffer would be invisible to it and
6738        // get silently dropped by this repack. Flush first so the whole
6739        // collection's committed bytes are scan-visible. Holding this
6740        // collection's put mutex means nothing can buffer behind it for this
6741        // collection between the flush and the scan.
6742        self.shards.flush_all()?;
6743
6744        let (hash_to_shard_offset, prev_state) = self.repack_scan_incremental(collection_id)?;
6745
6746        // Pin every shard this call could possibly read from before any
6747        // writes happen — see pin_shards' doc for why this must come
6748        // first.
6749        let pinned = self.pin_shards(hash_to_shard_offset.values().map(|&(id, _)| id));
6750
6751        let roots = self.live_roots.read().get(collection_id).cloned();
6752
6753        // Root-removal detection: if any root present in the previous repack's
6754        // snapshot is absent from the current root set, nodes exclusively
6755        // reachable through that removed root may be stuck in the cached live
6756        // set indefinitely (the incremental adjacency cache only grows — it has
6757        // no mechanism to re-derive reachability). Fall back to a full cold-start
6758        // BFS for this repack so those nodes can actually be collected. Once the
6759        // full sweep completes, the saved cursor is fresh and subsequent repacks
6760        // can be incremental again.
6761        let roots_shrunk = prev_state.as_ref().is_some_and(|prev| {
6762            let current_root_set: HashSet<[u8; 16]> =
6763                roots.as_deref().unwrap_or(&[]).iter().copied().collect();
6764            prev.prev_roots
6765                .iter()
6766                .any(|r| !current_root_set.contains(r))
6767        });
6768        // Use incremental adjacency only when prev state exists AND no root was removed.
6769        let use_incremental = prev_state.is_some() && !roots_shrunk;
6770
6771        let (live_hashes, adjacency) = match (roots.as_deref(), use_incremental) {
6772            (Some(roots), true) if !roots.is_empty() => {
6773                // Incremental BFS: only expand from roots not already in the
6774                // cached live set; reuse cached edge lists for everything else.
6775                Self::bfs_live_set_incremental(
6776                    &self.shards,
6777                    roots,
6778                    &hash_to_shard_offset,
6779                    prev_state.as_ref().expect("use_incremental implies Some"),
6780                    &pinned,
6781                    &extract_edges,
6782                )?
6783            }
6784            (Some(roots), false) if !roots.is_empty() => {
6785                // Cold-start BFS: root set shrank or first repack — full walk.
6786                Self::bfs_live_set(
6787                    &self.shards,
6788                    roots,
6789                    &hash_to_shard_offset,
6790                    &pinned,
6791                    &extract_edges,
6792                )?
6793            }
6794            (_, true) => {
6795                // No live roots, incremental path: only read disk for new nodes.
6796                Self::scan_full_adjacency_incremental(
6797                    &self.shards,
6798                    &hash_to_shard_offset,
6799                    prev_state.as_ref().expect("use_incremental implies Some"),
6800                    &pinned,
6801                    &extract_edges,
6802                )?
6803            }
6804            _ => {
6805                // No live roots, cold-start: preserve everything, read all.
6806                Self::scan_full_adjacency(
6807                    &self.shards,
6808                    &hash_to_shard_offset,
6809                    &pinned,
6810                    &extract_edges,
6811                )?
6812            }
6813        };
6814
6815        let dropped = hash_to_shard_offset.len().saturating_sub(live_hashes.len());
6816
6817        // Evict garbage-collected hashes from the collection's cache. Repack
6818        // carries the same cache forward into the new generation (below);
6819        // without this, a stale cache hit could still serve bytes for a
6820        // hash this pass just decided is unreachable, defeating GC.
6821        if dropped > 0 {
6822            let live_set: HashSet<[u8; 16]> = live_hashes.iter().copied().collect();
6823            if let Some(gen) = self.generation(collection_id) {
6824                for hash in hash_to_shard_offset.keys() {
6825                    if !live_set.contains(hash) {
6826                        let mut hex = String::with_capacity(32);
6827                        for b in hash {
6828                            let _ = write!(hex, "{b:02x}");
6829                        }
6830                        eprintln!("  dropped: {hex}");
6831                        gen.cache.remove(hash);
6832                    }
6833                }
6834            }
6835        }
6836
6837        let csr = Csr::build_from_edges(&live_hashes, &adjacency);
6838        let topo = csr.topo_order();
6839
6840        if topo.len() != live_hashes.len() {
6841            return Err(StorageError::Corrupt(format!(
6842                "repack: cyclic graph detected — topo_order produced {} nodes from {} live hashes",
6843                topo.len(),
6844                live_hashes.len(),
6845            )));
6846        }
6847
6848        // Copy into a non-source destination shard, never back into the
6849        // collection's current generation. Once the new index is published below,
6850        // this lets old source shards retire when no other collection references
6851        // them.
6852        let source_shards: HashSet<u16> = hash_to_shard_offset
6853            .values()
6854            .map(|&(slot, _)| slot)
6855            .collect();
6856        self.shards
6857            .prepare_collection_repack(collection_id, &source_shards)?;
6858
6859        let mut new_offsets: Vec<([u8; 16], u16, u64)> = Vec::with_capacity(topo.len());
6860        let mut new_disk_bytes = HashMap::new();
6861        for &local in &topo {
6862            let hash = csr
6863                .hash_of(local)
6864                .expect("topo order contains valid local IDs");
6865            let Some(&(old_slot, old_offset)) = hash_to_shard_offset.get(hash) else {
6866                continue;
6867            };
6868            if let Some((hash, slot, offset, disk_bytes)) =
6869                self.copy_record_to_shard(collection_id, &pinned, old_slot, old_offset)?
6870            {
6871                let pack_id = self
6872                    .shards
6873                    .get_shard(slot)
6874                    .map_or(u64::from(slot), |shard| shard.pack_id);
6875                let total = new_disk_bytes.entry(pack_id).or_insert(0_u64);
6876                *total = (*total).saturating_add(disk_bytes);
6877                new_offsets.push((hash, slot, offset));
6878            }
6879        }
6880
6881        let kept = new_offsets.len();
6882
6883        let index = Self::build_index(&new_offsets, self.index_config)?;
6884        self.replace_collection_disk_bytes(collection_id, &new_disk_bytes);
6885        self.replace_collection_shard_counts(
6886            collection_id,
6887            &self.slot_counts_to_pack_id_counts(&index.slot_counts()),
6888        );
6889        self.swap_generation(collection_id, index)?;
6890        self.retire_empty_shards(collection_id);
6891
6892        self.repack_count.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
6893        self.repack_kept_total
6894            .fetch_add(kept as u64, Ordering::Relaxed);
6895        self.repack_dropped_total
6896            .fetch_add(dropped as u64, Ordering::Relaxed);
6897        self.repack_counts_by_collection
6898            .write()
6899            .entry(*collection_id)
6900            .and_modify(|c| *c = c.saturating_add(1))
6901            .or_insert(1);
6902
6903        let current_roots: Vec<[u8; 16]> = roots.as_deref().unwrap_or(&[]).to_vec();
6904        self.repack_save_incremental_state(collection_id, &new_offsets, adjacency, &current_roots);
6905
6906        // Fsync the shards this repack just wrote into and persist the
6907        // updated stats snapshot as part of finishing the repack, rather
6908        // than leaving both to whatever the next unrelated sync_dirty()
6909        // call happens to be — a crash right after a repack should not
6910        // lose durability for data this repack itself just wrote, nor
6911        // leave the persisted stats stale relative to what's on disk.
6912        self.shards.sync_dirty()?;
6913
6914        // Release this collection's put_mutex before persisting the
6915        // checkpoint: persist_index_checkpoint acquires every collection's
6916        // put_mutex itself (parking_lot's Mutex is non-reentrant), and this
6917        // repack still holds this collection's.
6918        drop(collection_guard);
6919
6920        // retire_empty_shards may have unlinked packs this collection's old
6921        // index entries pointed at. A reader that reloads from the
6922        // checkpoint after this point must see the new shard layout, not
6923        // the stale one — otherwise reload_index_from_checkpoint rebuilds a
6924        // fingerprint that can never match a checkpoint naming retired
6925        // packs, and the read-journal reload path fails closed. Mark the
6926        // checkpoint dirty (repack itself never does, since it never runs
6927        // through the put/sync paths that do) and persist it now so the
6928        // on-disk checkpoint matches what this repack just wrote.
6929        //
6930        // Best-effort: the repack itself already succeeded and its shard
6931        // writes are durable (fsynced above). A checkpoint-write failure
6932        // here shouldn't be reported as a repack failure — the packfiles
6933        // stay authoritative and the dirty flag (left set on failure, see
6934        // `persist_index_checkpoint`) means the next sync retries it.
6935        self.index_checkpoint_dirty.store(true, Ordering::Relaxed);
6936        self.persist_index_checkpoint_best_effort();
6937        self.persist_shard_collections_best_effort();
6938
6939        Ok((kept, dropped))
6940    }
6941
6942    /// Repack several collections as one physical shard-compaction batch.
6943    ///
6944    /// The input is scanned once, then all replacement records are written
6945    /// through one shared destination stream. This is O(bytes + nodes), not
6946    /// O(collections × bytes), and avoids leaving one partially-filled destination
6947    /// shard behind for each collection.
6948    ///
6949    /// # Errors
6950    /// Returns [`StorageError`] on I/O, corruption, or an unavailable staging
6951    /// shard slot.
6952    ///
6953    /// # Panics
6954    /// Panics if the CSR implementation returns a local ID not present in its
6955    /// own hash table, which would violate its internal ordering invariant.
6956    pub fn repack_collections_reachable(
6957        &self,
6958        collection_ids: &[[u8; 16]],
6959        extract_edges: impl Fn(&[u8; 16], &[u8]) -> Vec<[u8; 16]>,
6960    ) -> Result<Vec<([u8; 16], usize, usize)>, StorageError> {
6961        self.repack_collections_reachable_with_progress(
6962            collection_ids,
6963            extract_edges,
6964            |_collection, _from, _to, _nodes, _complete| {},
6965        )
6966    }
6967
6968    /// As [`Self::repack_collections_reachable`], with a callback whenever the
6969    /// shared output stream rotates. The callback receives the collection whose
6970    /// copy crossed the boundary (or `None` at completion), the slot it
6971    /// rotated from, the replacement slot, the cumulative number of copied
6972    /// nodes, and whether the copy is complete.
6973    ///
6974    /// This lets an interactive caller show meaningful physical-compaction
6975    /// progress without turning the shared shard batch back into a
6976    /// collection-at-a-time operation.
6977    ///
6978    /// # Errors
6979    ///
6980    /// Returns [`StorageError`] on I/O, corruption, or an unavailable staging
6981    /// shard slot.
6982    ///
6983    /// # Panics
6984    ///
6985    /// Panics if the CSR implementation returns a local ID not present in its
6986    /// own hash table, which would violate its internal ordering invariant.
6987    fn report_repack_output_rotation(
6988        output_progress: &mut impl FnMut(Option<[u8; 16]>, u16, u16, usize, bool),
6989        active_output_shard: &mut u16,
6990        current_active_shard: u16,
6991        collection_id: &[u8; 16],
6992        copied_nodes: usize,
6993    ) {
6994        if current_active_shard != *active_output_shard {
6995            output_progress(
6996                Some(*collection_id),
6997                *active_output_shard,
6998                current_active_shard,
6999                copied_nodes,
7000                false,
7001            );
7002            *active_output_shard = current_active_shard;
7003        }
7004    }
7005
7006    fn copy_repack_batch_collection(
7007        &self,
7008        collection_id: &[u8; 16],
7009        hash_to_shard_offset: &RepackRecordMap,
7010        pinned: &HashMap<u16, Arc<Shard>>,
7011        extract_edges: &impl Fn(&[u8; 16], &[u8]) -> Vec<[u8; 16]>,
7012        output_progress: &mut impl FnMut(Option<[u8; 16]>, u16, u16, usize, bool),
7013        output_state: &mut (u16, usize),
7014    ) -> Result<(RepackOffsets, usize, HashMap<u64, u64>), StorageError> {
7015        let roots = self.live_roots.read().get(collection_id).cloned();
7016        let (live_hashes, adjacency) = match roots {
7017            Some(roots) if !roots.is_empty() => Self::bfs_live_set(
7018                &self.shards,
7019                &roots,
7020                hash_to_shard_offset,
7021                pinned,
7022                extract_edges,
7023            )?,
7024            _ => Self::scan_full_adjacency(
7025                &self.shards,
7026                hash_to_shard_offset,
7027                pinned,
7028                extract_edges,
7029            )?,
7030        };
7031        let dropped = hash_to_shard_offset.len().saturating_sub(live_hashes.len());
7032
7033        if dropped > 0 {
7034            let live_set: HashSet<[u8; 16]> = live_hashes.iter().copied().collect();
7035            if let Some(gen) = self.generation(collection_id) {
7036                for hash in hash_to_shard_offset.keys() {
7037                    if !live_set.contains(hash) {
7038                        gen.cache.remove(hash);
7039                    }
7040                }
7041            }
7042        }
7043
7044        let csr = Csr::build_from_edges(&live_hashes, &adjacency);
7045        let topo = csr.topo_order();
7046        if topo.len() != live_hashes.len() {
7047            return Err(StorageError::Corrupt(format!(
7048                "repack: cyclic graph detected — topo_order produced {} nodes from {} live hashes",
7049                topo.len(),
7050                live_hashes.len(),
7051            )));
7052        }
7053
7054        let mut new_offsets = Vec::with_capacity(topo.len());
7055        let mut new_disk_bytes = HashMap::new();
7056        for &local in &topo {
7057            let hash = csr
7058                .hash_of(local)
7059                .expect("topo order contains valid local IDs");
7060            let Some(&(old_slot, old_offset)) = hash_to_shard_offset.get(hash) else {
7061                continue;
7062            };
7063            if let Some((hash, slot, offset, disk_bytes)) =
7064                self.copy_record_to_shard(collection_id, pinned, old_slot, old_offset)?
7065            {
7066                output_state.1 = output_state.1.saturating_add(1);
7067                let current_active_shard = self.shards.active_shard().slot;
7068                Self::report_repack_output_rotation(
7069                    output_progress,
7070                    &mut output_state.0,
7071                    current_active_shard,
7072                    collection_id,
7073                    output_state.1,
7074                );
7075                let pack_id = self
7076                    .shards
7077                    .get_shard(slot)
7078                    .map_or(u64::from(slot), |shard| shard.pack_id);
7079                let total = new_disk_bytes.entry(pack_id).or_insert(0_u64);
7080                *total = (*total).saturating_add(disk_bytes);
7081                new_offsets.push((hash, slot, offset));
7082            }
7083        }
7084
7085        Ok((new_offsets, dropped, new_disk_bytes))
7086    }
7087
7088    /// As [`Self::repack_collections_reachable`], with a callback whenever the
7089    /// shared output stream rotates. The callback receives the collection whose
7090    /// copy crossed the boundary (or `None` at completion), the slot it
7091    /// rotated from, the replacement slot, the cumulative number of copied
7092    /// nodes, and whether the copy is complete.
7093    ///
7094    /// # Errors
7095    ///
7096    /// Returns [`StorageError`] on I/O, corruption, or an unavailable staging
7097    /// shard slot.
7098    ///
7099    /// # Panics
7100    ///
7101    /// Panics if the CSR implementation returns a local ID not present in its
7102    /// own hash table, which would violate its internal ordering invariant.
7103    pub fn repack_collections_reachable_with_progress(
7104        &self,
7105        collection_ids: &[[u8; 16]],
7106        extract_edges: impl Fn(&[u8; 16], &[u8]) -> Vec<[u8; 16]>,
7107        mut output_progress: impl FnMut(Option<[u8; 16]>, u16, u16, usize, bool),
7108    ) -> Result<Vec<([u8; 16], usize, usize)>, StorageError> {
7109        let mut collection_ids = collection_ids.to_vec();
7110        collection_ids.sort_unstable();
7111        collection_ids.dedup();
7112        if collection_ids.is_empty() {
7113            return Ok(Vec::new());
7114        }
7115
7116        // A batch is one coherent generation change. Hold every selected
7117        // collection's writer mutex in a stable order so a concurrent put cannot
7118        // be missed by the scan or revive an old source after the swap.
7119        let mutexes: Vec<_> = collection_ids.iter().map(|id| self.put_mutex(id)).collect();
7120        let collection_guards: Vec<_> = mutexes.iter().map(|mutex| mutex.lock()).collect();
7121
7122        // Same scan visibility requirement as the single-collection repack:
7123        // every selected collection's buffered frames must be on disk before
7124        // `scan_collection_record_maps` reads packfiles, or those records
7125        // would be dropped as if never written.
7126        self.shards.flush_all()?;
7127
7128        let maps = self.scan_collection_record_maps(&collection_ids)?;
7129        let source_shards: HashSet<u16> = maps
7130            .values()
7131            .flat_map(|map| map.values().map(|&(slot, _)| slot))
7132            .collect();
7133        let pinned = self.pin_shards(source_shards.iter().copied());
7134
7135        // Establish one common destination before copying the first frame.
7136        // `put_record` moves every collection to the same active successor when a
7137        // destination fills, so output remains densely packed across collections.
7138        self.shards
7139            .prepare_collections_repack(&collection_ids, &source_shards)?;
7140
7141        let mut results = Vec::with_capacity(collection_ids.len());
7142        let mut output_state = (self.shards.active_shard().slot, 0usize);
7143        for collection_id in &collection_ids {
7144            let hash_to_shard_offset = maps.get(collection_id).ok_or_else(|| {
7145                StorageError::Corrupt("repack batch scan lost requested collection".to_owned())
7146            })?;
7147            let (new_offsets, dropped, new_disk_bytes) = self.copy_repack_batch_collection(
7148                collection_id,
7149                hash_to_shard_offset,
7150                &pinned,
7151                &extract_edges,
7152                &mut output_progress,
7153                &mut output_state,
7154            )?;
7155            let kept = new_offsets.len();
7156            let index = Self::build_index(&new_offsets, self.index_config)?;
7157            self.replace_collection_disk_bytes(collection_id, &new_disk_bytes);
7158            self.replace_collection_shard_counts(
7159                collection_id,
7160                &self.slot_counts_to_pack_id_counts(&index.slot_counts()),
7161            );
7162            self.swap_generation(collection_id, index)?;
7163            // The batch path does a full cold-start scan (scan_collection_record_maps),
7164            // so we have no incremental adjacency to carry forward. Pass an empty
7165            // map so the next single-collection repack starts with a fresh cache
7166            // (it will populate it from the full BFS on that first pass).
7167            let batch_roots: Vec<[u8; 16]> = self
7168                .live_roots
7169                .read()
7170                .get(collection_id)
7171                .cloned()
7172                .unwrap_or_default();
7173            self.repack_save_incremental_state(
7174                collection_id,
7175                &new_offsets,
7176                HashMap::new(),
7177                &batch_roots,
7178            );
7179
7180            self.repack_count.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
7181            self.repack_kept_total
7182                .fetch_add(kept as u64, Ordering::Relaxed);
7183            self.repack_dropped_total
7184                .fetch_add(dropped as u64, Ordering::Relaxed);
7185            self.repack_counts_by_collection
7186                .write()
7187                .entry(*collection_id)
7188                .and_modify(|count| *count = count.saturating_add(1))
7189                .or_insert(1);
7190            results.push((*collection_id, kept, dropped));
7191        }
7192
7193        output_progress(None, output_state.0, output_state.0, output_state.1, true);
7194
7195        // All target collection locks remain held while source references are
7196        // replaced. Drop them before the general retirement protocol, which
7197        // obtains every collection lock itself.
7198        drop(collection_guards);
7199        self.retire_empty_shards_after_batch();
7200        self.shards.sync_dirty()?;
7201
7202        // See the matching comment in repack_collection_reachable: retirement
7203        // above may have unlinked packs this batch's old index entries
7204        // pointed at, so the on-disk checkpoint must be refreshed or a
7205        // reader's checkpoint reload can never match the live shard set.
7206        // Best-effort for the same reason: the batch's shard writes are
7207        // already durable, so a checkpoint-write failure here costs the
7208        // next sync a retry, not correctness.
7209        self.index_checkpoint_dirty.store(true, Ordering::Relaxed);
7210        self.persist_index_checkpoint_best_effort();
7211        self.persist_shard_collections_best_effort();
7212
7213        Ok(results)
7214    }
7215
7216    /// Fetches the ancestors of `frontier`, walking `extract_edges`
7217    /// backward and stopping expansion at (and excluding) anything in
7218    /// `stop_at` — a bounded ancestor walk, e.g. for edges or
7219    /// prev-event traversal from a caller-supplied frontier back to
7220    /// caller-supplied already-known boundary nodes.
7221    ///
7222    /// This is **not** a from/to range or span: if a branch's history
7223    /// never crosses any `stop_at` node (a fork off the main line, say),
7224    /// that branch is walked all the way back to the collection's true roots,
7225    /// not truncated at an implied boundary. A genuine "everything between
7226    /// these two frontiers" query is `ancestors(frontier) ∩
7227    /// descendants(stop_at)`, which needs reverse adjacency this doesn't
7228    /// build — `NodeId`s are content hashes with no key order to slice a
7229    /// real range query over, and this walk only covers the ancestor half.
7230    /// `limits.max_nodes` bounds the runaway case above.
7231    ///
7232    /// Returns nodes lazily, ancestor-first (parents before children,
7233    /// topologically), as a [`DagWalk`] iterator over data already
7234    /// resolved during the walk itself (no second per-node fetch against
7235    /// whatever generation happens to be live when the iterator is
7236    /// drained) — every record was matched by content hash, not just
7237    /// index tag, so an index-tag collision can't surface the wrong one.
7238    ///
7239    /// Read-only: resolves against one frozen generation snapshot via its
7240    /// internal breadth-first traversal and takes no `put_mutex`. Cost is
7241    /// proportional to the number of ancestors actually walked — one
7242    /// index lookup per node — not collection size, since it doesn't pre-scan
7243    /// every shard the way `repack_collection_reachable` does.
7244    ///
7245    /// # Errors
7246    /// Returns `StorageError` on I/O or corruption, or if the walk finds a
7247    /// cycle (an event graph must be acyclic; a cycle means the extracted
7248    /// edges are wrong or the data is corrupt).
7249    ///
7250    /// # Panics
7251    /// Panics if any hash in the CSR exceeds `u32::MAX` local ID space.
7252    pub fn walk_ancestors(
7253        &self,
7254        collection_id: &[u8; 16],
7255        frontier: &[[u8; 16]],
7256        stop_at: &[[u8; 16]],
7257        extract_edges: impl Fn(&[u8; 16], &[u8]) -> Vec<[u8; 16]>,
7258        limits: WalkLimits,
7259    ) -> Result<DagWalk, StorageError> {
7260        let Some(gen) = self.generation(collection_id).map(|g| Arc::clone(&g)) else {
7261            return Ok(DagWalk {
7262                order: Vec::new().into_iter(),
7263                resolved: HashMap::new(),
7264            });
7265        };
7266
7267        let ((live_hashes, adjacency), resolved) =
7268            self.bfs_ancestors(&gen, frontier, stop_at, &extract_edges, limits)?;
7269
7270        let csr = Csr::build_from_edges(&live_hashes, &adjacency);
7271        let mut topo = csr.topo_order();
7272
7273        if topo.len() != live_hashes.len() {
7274            return Err(StorageError::Corrupt(format!(
7275                "walk_ancestors: cyclic graph detected — topo_order produced {} nodes from {} live hashes",
7276                topo.len(),
7277                live_hashes.len(),
7278            )));
7279        }
7280
7281        // `extract_edges` points each node at its parents, so Kahn's
7282        // algorithm (which surfaces zero-incoming nodes first) naturally
7283        // yields children before parents. Reverse it: callers of an
7284        // ancestor walk want parents-before-children, the order data
7285        // could actually be replayed in.
7286        topo.reverse();
7287
7288        let order: Vec<[u8; 16]> = topo
7289            .into_iter()
7290            .map(|local| {
7291                *csr.hash_of(local)
7292                    .expect("topo order contains valid local IDs")
7293            })
7294            .collect();
7295
7296        Ok(DagWalk {
7297            order: order.into_iter(),
7298            resolved,
7299        })
7300    }
7301
7302    /// After a repack, scan all collections' indexes and retire any shard that
7303    /// no collection references.
7304    ///
7305    /// Acquires every collection's `put_mutex` (in sorted order, skipping the
7306    /// caller's already-held lock) to prevent a concurrent `put()` from
7307    /// landing a write in a shard whose index entry hasn't been inserted
7308    /// yet — without that, the scan could see zero references to a shard
7309    /// that a writer just committed bytes to but hasn't index-updated yet,
7310    /// causing a live shard to be retired under it.
7311    fn retire_empty_shards(&self, held_collection: &[u8; 16]) {
7312        // Collect collection IDs in sorted order for deadlock-free lock acquisition.
7313        // Skip the collection whose put_mutex the caller already holds.
7314        let mut collections_to_lock: Vec<[u8; 16]> = self
7315            .collections_read()
7316            .keys()
7317            .filter(|id| *id != held_collection)
7318            .copied()
7319            .collect();
7320        collections_to_lock.sort_unstable();
7321
7322        // Acquire all other collections' put_mutexes. The sorted order prevents
7323        // deadlocks; the held collection is skipped (parking_lot is non-reentrant).
7324        let mutexes: Vec<_> = collections_to_lock
7325            .iter()
7326            .map(|id| self.put_mutex(id))
7327            .collect();
7328        let _guards: Vec<_> = mutexes.iter().map(|m| m.lock()).collect();
7329
7330        self.retire_empty_shards_locked();
7331    }
7332
7333    /// Retire unreferenced shards after a batch has released all collection locks.
7334    /// This takes every collection lock itself, unlike [`Self::retire_empty_shards`]
7335    /// which is called while one particular collection lock is already held.
7336    fn retire_empty_shards_after_batch(&self) {
7337        let mut collection_ids: Vec<[u8; 16]> = self.collections_read().keys().copied().collect();
7338        collection_ids.sort_unstable();
7339        let mutexes: Vec<_> = collection_ids.iter().map(|id| self.put_mutex(id)).collect();
7340        let _guards: Vec<_> = mutexes.iter().map(|mutex| mutex.lock()).collect();
7341        self.retire_empty_shards_locked();
7342    }
7343
7344    /// Every collection writer lock is held by the caller.
7345    fn retire_empty_shards_locked(&self) {
7346        // Do not retain the map guard while acquiring collection locks: another
7347        // operation may need the map lock while it holds a collection lock.
7348        let collections = self.collections_read();
7349
7350        // Build the union of shard IDs referenced across all collections.
7351        let mut referenced = [false; shard::MAX_SHARDS];
7352        for gen_swap in collections.values() {
7353            let gen = gen_swap.load();
7354            let ids = gen.index.referenced_slot_ids();
7355            for (i, &has_refs) in ids.iter().enumerate() {
7356                referenced[i] |= has_refs;
7357            }
7358        }
7359
7360        // Retire any shard not in the union.
7361        for id in 0..u16::try_from(shard::MAX_SHARDS).unwrap() {
7362            if !referenced[id as usize] {
7363                self.shards.retire_slot(id);
7364            }
7365        }
7366        drop(collections);
7367        let mut tables = self.index_tables.write();
7368        let live_pack_ids: HashSet<u64> = tables
7369            .collection_shards
7370            .values()
7371            .flat_map(|packs| packs.iter().copied())
7372            .collect();
7373        tables
7374            .collection_disk_bytes
7375            .retain(|pack_id, _| live_pack_ids.contains(pack_id));
7376    }
7377}
7378
7379impl PackfileStorage {
7380    /// Fetch records and, if necessary, refresh a stale read-only collection
7381    /// index once before retrying only the missing keys.
7382    ///
7383    /// This is deliberately separate from [`StorageEngine::get_many`], whose
7384    /// result is a snapshot of the caller's current in-memory index. The
7385    /// refresh path is intended for multi-process readers that need to observe
7386    /// records appended by another process. Refreshes are serialized per
7387    /// collection and successful refreshes are rate-limited briefly so a run
7388    /// of genuine negative lookups cannot cause a full pack scan per lookup.
7389    ///
7390    /// A store whose in-memory index is authoritative (a single writer, see
7391    /// [`Self::set_refresh_on_miss`]) can disable the refresh entirely; the
7392    /// call then degrades to a plain [`StorageEngine::get_many`] snapshot,
7393    /// skipping the refresh path's miss scan/allocation and lock rather than
7394    /// the underlying index lookups.
7395    ///
7396    /// # Errors
7397    /// Returns [`StorageError`] if reading the collection or refreshing its
7398    /// on-disk index fails.
7399    pub fn get_many_with_refresh(
7400        &self,
7401        collection_id: &[u8; 16],
7402        ids: &[NodeId],
7403    ) -> Result<Vec<Option<NodeData>>, StorageError> {
7404        if !self.refresh_on_miss.load(Ordering::Relaxed) {
7405            return self.get_many(collection_id, ids);
7406        }
7407        let track = self.stats_enabled.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
7408        let _latency = if track {
7409            OperationTimer::new(&self.operation_timings.get_many_with_refresh)
7410        } else {
7411            OperationTimer::disabled()
7412        };
7413        let mut results = self.get_many(collection_id, ids)?;
7414        let mut missing: Vec<usize> = results
7415            .iter()
7416            .enumerate()
7417            .filter_map(|(index, value)| value.is_none().then_some(index))
7418            .collect();
7419        if missing.is_empty() {
7420            return Ok(results);
7421        }
7422
7423        let refresh_lock = self.refresh_lock(collection_id);
7424        let _refresh_guard = refresh_lock.lock();
7425
7426        // Another reader may have refreshed while this caller waited. Avoid a
7427        // second refresh and just recheck the keys against the new generation.
7428        let current_missing_ids: Vec<NodeId> = missing.iter().map(|&i| ids[i]).collect();
7429        let rechecked = self.get_many(collection_id, &current_missing_ids)?;
7430        for (index, value) in missing.iter().copied().zip(rechecked) {
7431            if value.is_some() {
7432                results[index] = value;
7433            }
7434        }
7435        missing.retain(|index| results[*index].is_none());
7436        if missing.is_empty() {
7437            return Ok(results);
7438        }
7439
7440        let durable_fp = match crate::index::checkpoint::read_durable_fingerprint(&self.base_dir) {
7441            Ok(Some(dfp)) => dfp,
7442            Ok(None) => crate::index::checkpoint::DurableFingerprint {
7443                fingerprint: 0,
7444                torn_tail: false,
7445            },
7446            Err(e) => {
7447                return Err(StorageError::Corrupt(format!(
7448                    "failed to read durable fingerprint: {e}"
7449                )));
7450            }
7451        };
7452
7453        let dominated = {
7454            let mut fingerprints = self.last_refresh_fingerprint.lock();
7455            let baseline = fingerprints
7456                .entry(*collection_id)
7457                .or_insert(self.initial_durable_fingerprint);
7458            *baseline == durable_fp.fingerprint
7459        };
7460
7461        if dominated && !durable_fp.torn_tail {
7462            self.miss_refresh_skips.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
7463            return Ok(results);
7464        }
7465
7466        self.refresh_and_retry(collection_id, ids, missing, &mut results)?;
7467        Ok(results)
7468    }
7469}
7470
7471impl PackfileStorage {
7472    fn append_put_many_entry(
7473        &self,
7474        collection_id: &[u8; 16],
7475        id: &NodeId,
7476        data: &NodeData,
7477        metadata: Option<FrameMetadata>,
7478        old_gen: Option<&RoomGeneration>,
7479        progress: &mut PutManyProgress,
7480    ) -> Result<(), StorageError> {
7481        let record = Record {
7482            collection_id: *collection_id,
7483            hash: *id,
7484            data: data.bytes.clone(),
7485            metadata,
7486        };
7487        let (slot, offset, disk_bytes) = self.shards.put_record_with_len(&record)?;
7488        self.publish_mutation(|| JournalMutation::Put {
7489            collection_id: *collection_id,
7490            node_id: *id,
7491            payload: data.bytes.to_vec(),
7492        })?;
7493        let pack_id = self
7494            .shards
7495            .get_shard(slot)
7496            .map_or(u64::from(slot), |shard| shard.pack_id);
7497        progress
7498            .pending_shard_collections
7499            .push((pack_id, disk_bytes));
7500        if progress.index_needs_rebuild {
7501            return Ok(());
7502        }
7503        let locator = RecordLocator {
7504            slot,
7505            offset,
7506            len: disk_bytes,
7507        };
7508        self.index_put_many_entry(collection_id, id, old_gen, locator, progress)
7509    }
7510
7511    fn index_put_many_entry(
7512        &self,
7513        collection_id: &[u8; 16],
7514        id: &NodeId,
7515        old_gen: Option<&RoomGeneration>,
7516        locator: RecordLocator,
7517        progress: &mut PutManyProgress,
7518    ) -> Result<(), StorageError> {
7519        let RecordLocator {
7520            slot,
7521            offset,
7522            len: record_len,
7523        } = locator;
7524        let live = match progress.owned_index.as_ref() {
7525            Some(index) => index,
7526            None => {
7527                &old_gen
7528                    .expect("live path implies an existing generation")
7529                    .index
7530            }
7531        };
7532        let insert_result = self.insert_index_undoable(collection_id, live, id, slot, offset)?;
7533        let inserted = if let Ok((_bucket, _entry, undo)) = insert_result {
7534            let was_empty = undo.was_empty();
7535            progress
7536                .pending_deltas
7537                .push((*id, slot, offset, record_len));
7538            if progress.owned_index.is_none() {
7539                progress.undo_log.push(undo);
7540            }
7541            was_empty
7542        } else {
7543            let grow_started = std::time::Instant::now();
7544            let grown = if let Some(grown) = live.grow() {
7545                Some(grown)
7546            } else {
7547                // Match the single-put fallback: if recovering the
7548                // checkpoint-backed hashes fails, rebuild this collection
7549                // from pack records below instead of aborting a valid batch.
7550                self.grow_checkpoint_index(collection_id, live)
7551                    .ok()
7552                    .flatten()
7553            };
7554            let Some(grown) = grown else {
7555                progress.index_needs_rebuild = true;
7556                progress.structural_change = true;
7557                progress.invalidate_delta = true;
7558                return Ok(());
7559            };
7560            // Growth is logical: the entry that hit the boundary is logged like
7561            // the others and replay grows the table, so no snapshot is needed.
7562            progress
7563                .pending_deltas
7564                .push((*id, slot, offset, record_len));
7565            progress.structural_change = true;
7566            self.index_grow_count.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
7567            self.index_clone_time_ns.fetch_add(
7568                u64::try_from(grow_started.elapsed().as_nanos()).unwrap_or(u64::MAX),
7569                Ordering::Relaxed,
7570            );
7571            let inserted = grown.insert(id, slot, offset).is_ok();
7572            progress.owned_index = Some(grown);
7573            inserted
7574        };
7575        if inserted {
7576            let pack_id = self
7577                .shards
7578                .get_shard(slot)
7579                .map_or(u64::from(slot), |shard| shard.pack_id);
7580            progress.pending_shard_collection_counts.push(pack_id);
7581        }
7582        Ok(())
7583    }
7584
7585    fn append_put_record(
7586        &self,
7587        collection_id: &[u8; 16],
7588        id: &NodeId,
7589        data: &NodeData,
7590        metadata: Option<FrameMetadata>,
7591    ) -> Result<(u16, u64, u64), StorageError> {
7592        let record = Record {
7593            collection_id: *collection_id,
7594            hash: *id,
7595            data: data.bytes.clone(),
7596            metadata,
7597        };
7598        let (slot, offset, disk_bytes) = self.shards.put_record_with_len(&record)?;
7599        self.publish_mutation(|| JournalMutation::Put {
7600            collection_id: *collection_id,
7601            node_id: *id,
7602            payload: data.bytes.to_vec(),
7603        })?;
7604        Ok((slot, offset, disk_bytes))
7605    }
7606
7607    /// Store a record after verifying that its bytes hash to `expected_digest`,
7608    /// attaching versioned metadata (logical id, content digest, role) to the
7609    /// frame so readers can recover it without decoding a caller-supplied
7610    /// addressing scheme.
7611    ///
7612    /// This is the verify-on-write entry point for callers that already know
7613    /// the content digest they expect (e.g. a Matrix event's canonical
7614    /// content hash). The digest is recomputed over the exact bytes being
7615    /// stored; a mismatch is rejected *before* anything is appended, so a
7616    /// corrupt or mis-addressed write never becomes durable.
7617    ///
7618    /// `logical_id` is the full 256-bit logical identity (e.g. the digest of
7619    /// the event id) stored in the metadata; it is independent of the
7620    /// 16-byte `id` used as the index key, which survives redaction.
7621    ///
7622    /// The digest function is caller-selectable via `algorithm` so a template
7623    /// or configuration can choose SHA-256 today and BLAKE3/SHA-512 later
7624    /// without a format break; the chosen algorithm is recorded in the frame
7625    /// metadata.
7626    ///
7627    /// # Errors
7628    /// Returns [`StorageError::Corrupt`] when the digest of `data` under
7629    /// `algorithm` does not equal `expected_digest`, and propagates any error
7630    /// from the underlying put.
7631    #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
7632    pub fn put_verified(
7633        &self,
7634        collection_id: &[u8; 16],
7635        id: &NodeId,
7636        data: &NodeData,
7637        logical_id: &Digest32,
7638        algorithm: DigestAlgorithm,
7639        expected_digest: &Digest32,
7640        role: Option<&[u8]>,
7641    ) -> Result<(), StorageError> {
7642        let digest = crate::storage::content_digest(algorithm, &data.bytes);
7643        if &digest != expected_digest {
7644            return Err(StorageError::Corrupt(format!(
7645                "content digest mismatch: expected {}, got {}",
7646                hex32(expected_digest),
7647                hex32(&digest)
7648            )));
7649        }
7650        let metadata = FrameMetadata {
7651            logical_id: Some(*logical_id),
7652            content_digest: Some(digest),
7653            digest_algorithm: algorithm,
7654            role: role.map(<[u8]>::to_vec),
7655            unknown: Vec::new(),
7656        };
7657        self.put_internal(collection_id, id, data, Some(metadata))
7658    }
7659
7660    fn prepare_put_many_progress(
7661        &self,
7662        old_gen: Option<&RoomGeneration>,
7663        entries_len: usize,
7664    ) -> PutManyProgress {
7665        let started = std::time::Instant::now();
7666        let owned_index = match old_gen {
7667            Some(generation) if !generation.index.is_mmap_backed() => None,
7668            Some(generation) => Some(generation.index.clone()),
7669            None => Some(LossyIndex::with_config(
7670                entries_len
7671                    .saturating_mul(2)
7672                    .max(NEW_COLLECTION_INDEX_FLOOR),
7673                self.index_config,
7674            )),
7675        };
7676        if owned_index.is_some() {
7677            self.put_many_clone_path_calls
7678                .fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
7679            self.index_clone_time_ns.fetch_add(
7680                u64::try_from(started.elapsed().as_nanos()).unwrap_or(u64::MAX),
7681                Ordering::Relaxed,
7682            );
7683        } else {
7684            self.put_many_fast_path_calls
7685                .fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
7686        }
7687        PutManyProgress {
7688            generation: old_gen.map_or(1, |generation| generation.generation),
7689            structural_change: owned_index.is_some(),
7690            owned_index,
7691            index_needs_rebuild: false,
7692            pending_deltas: Vec::with_capacity(entries_len),
7693            pending_shard_collections: Vec::with_capacity(entries_len),
7694            pending_shard_collection_counts: Vec::with_capacity(entries_len),
7695            invalidate_delta: false,
7696            undo_log: Vec::new(),
7697        }
7698    }
7699
7700    fn validate_put_many_inputs(
7701        collection_id: &[u8; 16],
7702        entries: &[(NodeId, NodeData)],
7703    ) -> Result<bool, StorageError> {
7704        if entries.is_empty() {
7705            return Ok(false);
7706        }
7707        for (id, data) in entries {
7708            ShardPool::validate_record(&Record {
7709                collection_id: *collection_id,
7710                hash: *id,
7711                data: data.bytes.clone(),
7712                metadata: None,
7713            })?;
7714        }
7715        Ok(true)
7716    }
7717
7718    fn put_internal(
7719        &self,
7720        collection_id: &[u8; 16],
7721        id: &NodeId,
7722        data: &NodeData,
7723        metadata: Option<FrameMetadata>,
7724    ) -> Result<(), StorageError> {
7725        let collection_arc = self.put_mutex(collection_id);
7726        let _collection_guard = collection_arc.lock();
7727        self.put_internal_locked(collection_id, id, data, metadata)
7728    }
7729
7730    fn put_internal_locked(
7731        &self,
7732        collection_id: &[u8; 16],
7733        id: &NodeId,
7734        data: &NodeData,
7735        metadata: Option<FrameMetadata>,
7736    ) -> Result<(), StorageError> {
7737        self.put_calls.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
7738        self.put_bytes
7739            .fetch_add(data.bytes.len() as u64, Ordering::Relaxed);
7740        // New-collection puts must not interleave their record flush with a
7741        // concurrent checkpoint's fingerprint→snapshot window (see
7742        // `persist_index_checkpoint`). Existing collections are already gated
7743        // by their `put_mutex`; a brand-new one isn't in that set yet, so we
7744        // hold the publication lock shared for the whole put instead — the
7745        // checkpoint holds it exclusive, excluding this put from the window.
7746        let _create_guard = if self.generation(collection_id).is_none() {
7747            Some(self.collection_creation.read())
7748        } else {
7749            None
7750        };
7751
7752        let (slot, offset, disk_bytes) =
7753            self.append_put_record(collection_id, id, data, metadata)?;
7754        if let Some(gen) = self.generation(collection_id) {
7755            if !gen.index.is_mmap_backed() {
7756                if let Ok((_bucket, _entry, inserted)) =
7757                    self.insert_index(collection_id, &gen.index, id, slot, offset)?
7758                {
7759                    self.record_redo(collection_id, gen.generation, id, slot, offset, disk_bytes);
7760                    let pack_id = self
7761                        .shards
7762                        .get_shard(slot)
7763                        .map_or(u64::from(slot), |shard| shard.pack_id);
7764                    if inserted {
7765                        self.record_new_shard_collection(pack_id, collection_id, disk_bytes);
7766                    } else {
7767                        self.record_disk_bytes(pack_id, collection_id, disk_bytes);
7768                    }
7769
7770                    let mut data_to_cache = data.clone();
7771                    for child in &mut data_to_cache.children {
7772                        if let NodeRef::Lazy(child_id) = child {
7773                            if let Some(child_data) = self.pinned.get(child_id) {
7774                                *child = NodeRef::Resolved(*child_id, child_data);
7775                            }
7776                        }
7777                    }
7778                    gen.cache.insert(*id, Arc::new(data_to_cache));
7779                    self.index_checkpoint_dirty.store(true, Ordering::Relaxed);
7780                    return Ok(());
7781                }
7782            }
7783        }
7784        let (index, cache) = {
7785            let old_gen = self.generation(collection_id);
7786            let generation = old_gen.as_ref().map_or(1, |g| g.generation);
7787            let mut index = match &old_gen {
7788                Some(g) => g.index.clone(),
7789                // A brand-new collection's first insert: no count hint to
7790                // size from (unlike `put_many`, which knows `entries.len()`),
7791                // so start at a small fixed floor and let `grow()` size it
7792                // up as real entries land. Previously this was a flat
7793                // 4096-slot (32 KiB) floor per collection regardless of how
7794                // many records it would ever hold -- workloads with many
7795                // small/near-empty collections (e.g. per-room collections
7796                // holding a handful of records each) paid that 32 KiB up
7797                // front per collection, dwarfing the actual data by orders
7798                // of magnitude.
7799                //
7800                // See `NEW_COLLECTION_INDEX_FLOOR` for why this isn't the
7801                // index's own smaller hard floor.
7802                None => LossyIndex::with_config(NEW_COLLECTION_INDEX_FLOOR, self.index_config),
7803            };
7804            let inserted = self.insert_index(collection_id, &index, id, slot, offset)?;
7805            if let Ok((_bucket, _entry, is_new)) = inserted {
7806                self.record_redo(collection_id, generation, id, slot, offset, disk_bytes);
7807                let pack_id = self
7808                    .shards
7809                    .get_shard(slot)
7810                    .map_or(u64::from(slot), |s| s.pack_id);
7811                if is_new {
7812                    self.record_new_shard_collection(pack_id, collection_id, disk_bytes);
7813                } else {
7814                    self.record_disk_bytes(pack_id, collection_id, disk_bytes);
7815                }
7816            } else {
7817                // The insert was rejected (table full). Capacity growth changes
7818                // the table's shape but not what a logical redo record says, so
7819                // it does not invalidate the delta log: the record that hit the
7820                // boundary is logged like any other, and replay grows the table
7821                // itself. Only a rebuild re-derives the collection wholesale.
7822                if let Some(grown) = index.grow() {
7823                    // The failed insert did not mutate the table, so retry it
7824                    // after the in-memory rehash. This is the normal capacity
7825                    // path and must not turn into a full-pack scan.
7826                    let _ = grown.insert(id, slot, offset);
7827                    index = grown;
7828                    self.record_redo(collection_id, generation, id, slot, offset, disk_bytes);
7829                } else if let Ok(Some(grown)) = self.grow_checkpoint_index(collection_id, &index) {
7830                    // A checkpoint-backed index has locations but not homes.
7831                    // Recovering the hashes from those locations is bounded
7832                    // by this collection, unlike `rebuild_index`'s pack scan.
7833                    let _ = grown.insert(id, slot, offset);
7834                    index = grown;
7835                    self.record_redo(collection_id, generation, id, slot, offset, disk_bytes);
7836                } else {
7837                    self.invalidate_delta_log(collection_id);
7838                    index = self.rebuild_index(collection_id)?;
7839                    let _ = index.insert(id, slot, offset);
7840                }
7841                // The rebuild re-derived the collection's entire live set from
7842                // scratch, so its shard distribution needs a full
7843                // recompute too, not just crediting this one record.
7844                self.replace_collection_shard_counts(
7845                    collection_id,
7846                    &self.slot_counts_to_pack_id_counts(&index.slot_counts()),
7847                );
7848                // The recompute above covers live-node counts only. This frame
7849                // was appended either way, so its bytes still have to be added
7850                // (the branches above account for it themselves).
7851                let pack_id = self
7852                    .shards
7853                    .get_shard(slot)
7854                    .map_or(u64::from(slot), |s| s.pack_id);
7855                self.record_disk_bytes(pack_id, collection_id, disk_bytes);
7856            }
7857            let cache = match &old_gen {
7858                Some(g) => g.cache.clone(),
7859                None => Arc::new(NodeCache::new(self.cache_capacity)),
7860            };
7861
7862            let mut data_to_cache = data.clone();
7863            for child in &mut data_to_cache.children {
7864                if let NodeRef::Lazy(child_id) = child {
7865                    if let Some(child_data) = self.pinned.get(child_id) {
7866                        *child = NodeRef::Resolved(*child_id, child_data);
7867                    }
7868                }
7869            }
7870            cache.insert(*id, Arc::new(data_to_cache));
7871
7872            (index, cache)
7873        };
7874
7875        self.store_generation(collection_id, index, Some(cache), false)?;
7876
7877        Ok(())
7878    }
7879
7880    fn put_many_internal(
7881        &self,
7882        collection_id: &[u8; 16],
7883        entries: &[(NodeId, NodeData)],
7884        metadatas: Option<&[Option<FrameMetadata>]>,
7885    ) -> Result<usize, StorageError> {
7886        let collection_arc = self.put_mutex(collection_id);
7887        let _collection_guard = collection_arc.lock();
7888        let written = self.put_many_internal_locked(collection_id, entries, metadatas)?;
7889        if written > 0 {
7890            self.put_many_calls.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
7891            self.put_many_records
7892                .fetch_add(written as u64, Ordering::Relaxed);
7893            self.put_many_bytes.fetch_add(
7894                entries
7895                    .iter()
7896                    .map(|(_, data)| data.bytes.len() as u64)
7897                    .sum::<u64>(),
7898                Ordering::Relaxed,
7899            );
7900        }
7901        Ok(written)
7902    }
7903
7904    fn put_many_internal_locked(
7905        &self,
7906        collection_id: &[u8; 16],
7907        entries: &[(NodeId, NodeData)],
7908        metadatas: Option<&[Option<FrameMetadata>]>,
7909    ) -> Result<usize, StorageError> {
7910        if let Some(metadatas) = metadatas {
7911            debug_assert_eq!(
7912                metadatas.len(),
7913                entries.len(),
7914                "per-entry metadata must align with entries"
7915            );
7916        }
7917        if !Self::validate_put_many_inputs(collection_id, entries)? {
7918            return Ok(0);
7919        }
7920
7921        // Same comment as in `put`: a brand-new collection must be excluded
7922        // from a concurrent checkpoint's fingerprint→snapshot window.
7923        let create_guard = if self.generation(collection_id).is_none() {
7924            Some(self.collection_creation.read())
7925        } else {
7926            None
7927        };
7928
7929        let old_gen = self.generation(collection_id);
7930        let cache = match &old_gen {
7931            Some(g) => g.cache.clone(),
7932            None => Arc::new(NodeCache::new(self.cache_capacity)),
7933        };
7934
7935        let mut progress = self.prepare_put_many_progress(
7936            old_gen.as_deref().map(|generation| &**generation),
7937            entries.len(),
7938        );
7939        // Undo entries for writes made directly to `old_gen`'s live index
7940        // (only populated while `owned_index` is still `None`). Replayed in
7941        // reverse on any later failure so the live index never ends up
7942        // observably holding a failed batch's partial prefix -- the
7943        // property the unconditional clone used to provide for free.
7944        macro_rules! rollback_and_fail {
7945            ($error:expr) => {{
7946                if let Some(g) = &old_gen {
7947                    for undo in progress.undo_log.iter().rev() {
7948                        g.index.rollback_slot(undo);
7949                    }
7950                }
7951                drop(create_guard);
7952                return Err(self.persist_failed_batch_boundary($error));
7953            }};
7954        }
7955
7956        for (index, (id, data)) in entries.iter().enumerate() {
7957            let metadata = metadatas.and_then(|m| m.get(index)).cloned().flatten();
7958            if let Err(error) = self.append_put_many_entry(
7959                collection_id,
7960                id,
7961                data,
7962                metadata,
7963                old_gen.as_deref().map(|generation| &**generation),
7964                &mut progress,
7965            ) {
7966                rollback_and_fail!(error);
7967            }
7968        }
7969
7970        if progress.index_needs_rebuild {
7971            let rebuilt = match self.rebuild_index(collection_id) {
7972                Ok(index) => index,
7973                Err(error) => rollback_and_fail!(error),
7974            };
7975            // rebuild_index automatically discovers all the records we just appended
7976            self.replace_collection_shard_counts(
7977                collection_id,
7978                &self.slot_counts_to_pack_id_counts(&rebuilt.slot_counts()),
7979            );
7980            progress.owned_index = Some(rebuilt);
7981        }
7982
7983        // All fallible work is complete. Only now make the batch visible to
7984        // the shared index, delta state, and shard bookkeeping.
7985        if progress.invalidate_delta {
7986            self.invalidate_delta_log(collection_id);
7987        } else {
7988            for (id, slot, offset, record_len) in progress.pending_deltas {
7989                self.record_redo(
7990                    collection_id,
7991                    progress.generation,
7992                    &id,
7993                    slot,
7994                    offset,
7995                    record_len,
7996                );
7997            }
7998        }
7999        self.record_put_many_shard_collections(
8000            collection_id,
8001            &progress.pending_shard_collection_counts,
8002            &progress.pending_shard_collections,
8003        );
8004
8005        // Apply cache mutations only after all disk writes succeed, so a
8006        // failed batch does not leak partial state into the shared cache.
8007        // Resolve and insert one entry at a time: retaining a prepared clone
8008        // of the entire batch here would defeat the cache's size bound.
8009        for (id, data) in entries {
8010            let mut data_to_cache = data.clone();
8011            for child in &mut data_to_cache.children {
8012                if let NodeRef::Lazy(child_id) = child {
8013                    if let Some(child_data) = self.pinned.get(child_id) {
8014                        *child = NodeRef::Resolved(*child_id, child_data);
8015                    }
8016                }
8017            }
8018            cache.insert(*id, Arc::new(data_to_cache));
8019        }
8020
8021        if progress.structural_change {
8022            let index = progress
8023                .owned_index
8024                .expect("structural_change is only set once owned_index is materialized");
8025            if let Err(error) = self.store_generation(collection_id, index, Some(cache), false) {
8026                rollback_and_fail!(error);
8027            }
8028        } else {
8029            // Every record landed on the live, already-published index in
8030            // place -- no new generation to publish, matching `put`'s
8031            // in-place success path.
8032            self.index_checkpoint_dirty.store(true, Ordering::Relaxed);
8033        }
8034
8035        Ok(entries.len())
8036    }
8037}
8038
8039impl StorageEngine for PackfileStorage {
8040    fn collection_exists(&self, collection_id: &[u8; 16]) -> Result<bool, StorageError> {
8041        self.try_collection_exists(collection_id)
8042    }
8043
8044    fn collection_len(&self, collection_id: &[u8; 16]) -> Result<Option<usize>, StorageError> {
8045        self.try_collection_len(collection_id)
8046    }
8047
8048    fn create_or_put_established(
8049        &self,
8050        collection_id: &[u8; 16],
8051        metadata: &CollectionMetadata,
8052        records: &[(NodeId, NodeData)],
8053    ) -> Result<(), StorageError> {
8054        validate_established_batch_inputs(records)?;
8055        if !metadata.verify_collection_id(collection_id) {
8056            return Err(StorageError::Internal(
8057                "collection metadata does not reproduce collection id".to_owned(),
8058            ));
8059        }
8060        if metadata.collection_canonical_id.is_empty() {
8061            return Err(StorageError::Internal(
8062                "collection metadata has empty canonical id".to_owned(),
8063            ));
8064        }
8065
8066        let collection_arc = self.put_mutex(collection_id);
8067        let _collection_guard = collection_arc.lock();
8068
8069        if let Some(existing) = self.get(collection_id, &COLLECTION_METADATA_RECORD_ID)? {
8070            let found = CollectionMetadata::decode(&existing.bytes).ok_or_else(|| {
8071                StorageError::Corrupt("malformed collection metadata record".to_owned())
8072            })?;
8073            if found != *metadata {
8074                found.validate_identity_collision(metadata, collection_id)?;
8075                return Err(StorageError::Internal(
8076                    "collection metadata mismatch: existing genesis record differs".to_owned(),
8077                ));
8078            }
8079            let mut to_append = Vec::with_capacity(records.len());
8080            for (id, data) in records {
8081                if let Some(existing_rec) = self.get(collection_id, id)? {
8082                    if existing_rec.bytes != data.bytes {
8083                        return Err(StorageError::Collision(format!(
8084                            "record collision on node {}",
8085                            hex16(id)
8086                        )));
8087                    }
8088                } else {
8089                    to_append.push((*id, data.clone()));
8090                }
8091            }
8092            if to_append.len() == 1 {
8093                let (id, data) = &to_append[0];
8094                return self.put_internal_locked(collection_id, id, data, None);
8095            } else if !to_append.is_empty() {
8096                self.put_many_internal_locked(collection_id, &to_append, None)?;
8097            }
8098        } else {
8099            if self.collection_exists(collection_id) {
8100                return Err(StorageError::Internal(
8101                    "genesis metadata must be written before the collection's first record"
8102                        .to_owned(),
8103                ));
8104            }
8105            let mut batch = Vec::with_capacity(records.len().saturating_add(1));
8106            batch.push((
8107                COLLECTION_METADATA_RECORD_ID,
8108                NodeData::new(metadata.encode().into()),
8109            ));
8110            batch.extend_from_slice(records);
8111            self.put_many_internal_locked(collection_id, &batch, None)?;
8112        }
8113        Ok(())
8114    }
8115
8116    fn put_many_established(
8117        &self,
8118        collection_id: &[u8; 16],
8119        records: &[(NodeId, NodeData)],
8120    ) -> Result<(), StorageError> {
8121        validate_established_batch_inputs(records)?;
8122        if records.is_empty() {
8123            return Ok(());
8124        }
8125
8126        let collection_arc = self.put_mutex(collection_id);
8127        let _collection_guard = collection_arc.lock();
8128
8129        let Some(existing) = self.get(collection_id, &COLLECTION_METADATA_RECORD_ID)? else {
8130            return Err(StorageError::NotFound(*collection_id));
8131        };
8132        let found = CollectionMetadata::decode(&existing.bytes).ok_or_else(|| {
8133            StorageError::Corrupt("malformed collection metadata record".to_owned())
8134        })?;
8135        if !found.verify_collection_id(collection_id) {
8136            return Err(StorageError::Corrupt(
8137                "stored collection metadata does not reproduce collection id".to_owned(),
8138            ));
8139        }
8140
8141        let to_append =
8142            collect_missing_established_records(records, |id| self.get(collection_id, id))?;
8143        if !to_append.is_empty() {
8144            let written = self.put_many_internal_locked(collection_id, &to_append, None)?;
8145            if written > 0 {
8146                self.put_many_calls.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
8147                self.put_many_records
8148                    .fetch_add(written as u64, Ordering::Relaxed);
8149                self.put_many_bytes.fetch_add(
8150                    to_append
8151                        .iter()
8152                        .map(|(_, data)| data.bytes.len() as u64)
8153                        .sum::<u64>(),
8154                    Ordering::Relaxed,
8155                );
8156            }
8157        }
8158        Ok(())
8159    }
8160
8161    fn create_or_upsert_established_validated(
8162        &self,
8163        collection_id: &[u8; 16],
8164        metadata: &CollectionMetadata,
8165        node_id: &NodeId,
8166        data: &NodeData,
8167        validate: &mut dyn FnMut(Option<&NodeData>) -> Result<(), StorageError>,
8168    ) -> Result<(), StorageError> {
8169        validate_established_upsert_inputs(collection_id, metadata, node_id)?;
8170
8171        let collection_arc = self.put_mutex(collection_id);
8172        let _collection_guard = collection_arc.lock();
8173
8174        if let Some(existing_meta_rec) = self.get(collection_id, &COLLECTION_METADATA_RECORD_ID)? {
8175            let found = CollectionMetadata::decode(&existing_meta_rec.bytes).ok_or_else(|| {
8176                StorageError::Corrupt("malformed collection metadata record".to_owned())
8177            })?;
8178            if found != *metadata {
8179                found.validate_identity_collision(metadata, collection_id)?;
8180                return Err(StorageError::Internal(
8181                    "collection metadata mismatch: existing genesis record differs".to_owned(),
8182                ));
8183            }
8184
8185            let existing = self.get(collection_id, node_id)?;
8186            validate(existing.as_ref())?;
8187
8188            if let Some(existing) = existing {
8189                if existing.bytes == data.bytes {
8190                    return Ok(());
8191                }
8192            }
8193
8194            self.put_internal_locked(collection_id, node_id, data, None)?;
8195        } else {
8196            if self.collection_exists(collection_id) {
8197                return Err(StorageError::Internal(
8198                    "genesis metadata must be written before the collection's first record"
8199                        .to_owned(),
8200                ));
8201            }
8202
8203            validate(None)?;
8204
8205            let batch = [
8206                (
8207                    COLLECTION_METADATA_RECORD_ID,
8208                    NodeData::new(metadata.encode().into()),
8209                ),
8210                (*node_id, data.clone()),
8211            ];
8212            self.put_many_internal_locked(collection_id, &batch, None)?;
8213        }
8214
8215        Ok(())
8216    }
8217
8218    fn ensure_collection_metadata(
8219        &self,
8220        collection_id: &[u8; 16],
8221        metadata: &CollectionMetadata,
8222    ) -> Result<(), StorageError> {
8223        self.create_or_put_established(collection_id, metadata, &[])
8224    }
8225
8226    fn get(&self, collection_id: &[u8; 16], id: &NodeId) -> Result<Option<NodeData>, StorageError> {
8227        let track = self.stats_enabled.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
8228        let _latency = if track {
8229            OperationTimer::new(&self.operation_timings.get)
8230        } else {
8231            OperationTimer::disabled()
8232        };
8233        if self.overlay_reads_active() {
8234            return Ok(self
8235                .get_read_committed(collection_id, std::slice::from_ref(id))?
8236                .into_iter()
8237                .next()
8238                .flatten());
8239        }
8240        // A concurrent repack can swap the generation and retire the shard ids
8241        // its index pointed at. Pin the candidate shards and confirm the
8242        // generation did not change between the index lookup and the pin
8243        // (retirement only follows a swap); retry against the new generation if
8244        // it did.
8245        loop {
8246            let gen_guard = self.generation(collection_id);
8247            let Some(gen) = gen_guard.as_deref() else {
8248                if track {
8249                    self.get_calls.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
8250                    self.get_misses.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
8251                }
8252                return Ok(None);
8253            };
8254            if let Some(data) = gen.cache.get(id) {
8255                if track {
8256                    self.get_calls.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
8257                }
8258                return Ok(Some((*data).clone()));
8259            }
8260            let candidates: Vec<(u16, u64)> = gen.index.lookup_all(id).collect();
8261            #[cfg(test)]
8262            Self::run_test_before_pin();
8263            let pinned = self.pin_shards(candidates.iter().map(|&(slot, _)| slot));
8264            let still_current = match gen_guard.as_ref() {
8265                Some(loaded) => {
8266                    let current = self.generation(collection_id);
8267                    Self::same_generation(current.as_ref(), loaded)
8268                }
8269                None => true,
8270            };
8271            if !still_current {
8272                continue;
8273            }
8274            if track {
8275                self.index_candidates
8276                    .fetch_add(candidates.len() as u64, Ordering::Relaxed);
8277            }
8278            let result = self.resolve_from_pinned(id, &candidates, &pinned, track);
8279            if track {
8280                self.get_calls.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
8281                if result.as_ref().is_ok_and(Option::is_none) {
8282                    self.get_misses.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
8283                }
8284            }
8285            return result;
8286        }
8287    }
8288
8289    fn get_many(
8290        &self,
8291        collection_id: &[u8; 16],
8292        ids: &[NodeId],
8293    ) -> Result<Vec<Option<NodeData>>, StorageError> {
8294        let track = self.stats_enabled.load(Ordering::Relaxed);
8295        let _latency = if track {
8296            OperationTimer::new(&self.operation_timings.get_many)
8297        } else {
8298            OperationTimer::disabled()
8299        };
8300        if self.overlay_reads_active() {
8301            return self.get_read_committed(collection_id, ids);
8302        }
8303        // As in `get`: pin the candidate shards and retry if a concurrent
8304        // repack swapped the generation (and so may have retired them) between
8305        // the index lookups and the pin.
8306        loop {
8307            let mut results: Vec<Option<NodeData>> = vec![None; ids.len()];
8308
8309            let gen_guard = self.generation(collection_id);
8310            let mut to_fetch: Vec<(usize, Vec<(u16, u64)>)> = Vec::new();
8311            let mut candidates_seen: u64 = 0;
8312            if let Some(g) = gen_guard.as_deref() {
8313                for (i, id) in ids.iter().enumerate() {
8314                    // The generation-local cache only contains records from this
8315                    // generation, so it is authoritative for hits. Avoid an
8316                    // otherwise redundant index probe for the common warm case.
8317                    if let Some(data) = g.cache.get(id) {
8318                        results[i] = Some((*data).clone());
8319                        continue;
8320                    }
8321                    let candidates: Vec<(u16, u64)> = g.index.lookup_all(id).collect();
8322                    candidates_seen = candidates_seen.saturating_add(candidates.len() as u64);
8323                    if !candidates.is_empty() {
8324                        to_fetch.push((i, candidates));
8325                    }
8326                }
8327            }
8328
8329            #[cfg(test)]
8330            Self::run_test_before_pin();
8331            let pinned = self.pin_shards(
8332                to_fetch
8333                    .iter()
8334                    .flat_map(|(_, candidates)| candidates.iter().map(|&(slot, _)| slot)),
8335            );
8336            let still_current = match gen_guard.as_ref() {
8337                Some(loaded) => {
8338                    let current = self.generation(collection_id);
8339                    Self::same_generation(current.as_ref(), loaded)
8340                }
8341                None => true,
8342            };
8343            if !still_current {
8344                continue;
8345            }
8346
8347            to_fetch.sort_unstable_by_key(|(_, candidates)| candidates[0]);
8348
8349            let policy = self.read_plan_policy();
8350            let plan_wanted = policy.wants(usize::try_from(candidates_seen).unwrap_or(usize::MAX));
8351
8352            // Suppress readahead for a scattered batch when asked. This is
8353            // independent of extent planning: it reads the same pages either
8354            // way, it just stops the kernel from over-reading first.
8355            if policy.random_advice && candidates_seen > 0 {
8356                Self::advise_random(&pinned);
8357            }
8358
8359            // One grouping of candidate offsets per shard feeds both the
8360            // scatter counters and the merged read plan below.
8361            let mut per_shard: HashMap<u16, Vec<u64>> = HashMap::new();
8362            if track || plan_wanted {
8363                for (_, candidates) in &to_fetch {
8364                    for (slot, offset) in candidates {
8365                        per_shard.entry(*slot).or_default().push(*offset);
8366                    }
8367                }
8368                for offsets in per_shard.values_mut() {
8369                    offsets.sort_unstable();
8370                }
8371            }
8372
8373            if track {
8374                self.index_candidates
8375                    .fetch_add(candidates_seen, Ordering::Relaxed);
8376                self.get_many_shards_touched
8377                    .fetch_add(per_shard.len() as u64, Ordering::Relaxed);
8378
8379                let mut runs: u64 = 0;
8380                let mut span: u64 = 0;
8381                for offsets in per_shard.values() {
8382                    let first = *offsets.first().expect("offsets non-empty by construction");
8383                    let last = *offsets.last().expect("offsets non-empty by construction");
8384                    runs = runs.saturating_add(1);
8385                    span = span.saturating_add(last.saturating_sub(first));
8386                    for pair in offsets.windows(2) {
8387                        if pair[1].saturating_sub(pair[0]) > READ_RUN_GAP_BYTES {
8388                            runs = runs.saturating_add(1);
8389                        }
8390                    }
8391                }
8392                self.read_many_runs.fetch_add(runs, Ordering::Relaxed);
8393                self.read_many_span_bytes.fetch_add(span, Ordering::Relaxed);
8394            }
8395
8396            // Meld nearby candidates into contiguous extents and hint the
8397            // kernel to read each as one sequential run, before the
8398            // per-candidate decode loop touches them one at a time.
8399            if plan_wanted {
8400                let extents = plan_read_extents(&per_shard, policy);
8401                self.prefetch_extents(&extents, &pinned, track);
8402            }
8403
8404            for (i, candidates) in &to_fetch {
8405                results[*i] = self.resolve_from_pinned(&ids[*i], candidates, &pinned, track)?;
8406            }
8407
8408            if track {
8409                self.get_many_calls.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
8410                self.get_many_records
8411                    .fetch_add(ids.len() as u64, Ordering::Relaxed);
8412                self.get_many_misses.fetch_add(
8413                    results.iter().filter(|r| r.is_none()).count() as u64,
8414                    Ordering::Relaxed,
8415                );
8416            }
8417
8418            return Ok(results);
8419        }
8420    }
