17051    #[test]
17052    fn test_repack_closure_pulls_in_collections_second_shard_transitively() {
17053        // Collection A lives on shards {0, 1} (spans a rotation). Collection B lives
17054        // only on shard 1. Starting the closure from shard 0 must still
17055        // discover shard 1 (because collection A references it) and, through
17056        // shard 1, collection B — even though collection B never touched shard 0 at
17057        // all.
17058        let dir = test_dir("closure_transitive");
17059        let store = PackfileStorage::open(dir).unwrap();
17060
17061        store
17062            .put(
17063                &TEST_COLLECTION,
17064                &distinct_id(0),
17065                &NodeData::new(bytes::Bytes::from_static(b"a-on-shard-0")),
17066            )
17067            .unwrap();
17068
17069        // Force rotation so TEST_COLLECTION's next write lands on a new shard.
17070        store.shards.active_shard().file_len.store(
17071            shard::MAX_SHARD_BYTES - 10,
17072            std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Release,
17073        );
17074        store
17075            .put(
17076                &TEST_COLLECTION,
17077                &distinct_id(1),
17078                &NodeData::new(bytes::Bytes::from_static(b"a-on-shard-1")),
17079            )
17080            .unwrap();
17081
17082        store
17083            .put(
17084                &OTHER_COLLECTION,
17085                &distinct_id(2),
17086                &NodeData::new(bytes::Bytes::from_static(b"b-on-shard-1")),
17087            )
17088            .unwrap();
17089
17090        let (mut collections, mut shards) = store.repack_closure(0).unwrap();
17091        collections.sort_unstable();
17092        shards.sort_unstable();
17093        let mut expected_collections = vec![TEST_COLLECTION, OTHER_COLLECTION];
17094        expected_collections.sort_unstable();
17095        assert_eq!(collections, expected_collections);
17096        assert_eq!(shards, vec![0, 1]);
17097    }

17146    /// `pin_shards` must return a distinct `Arc<Shard>` per unique id, and
17147    /// the returned handle must still resolve real, previously-written
17148    /// data — i.e. it's the live pool's own shard, not a stand-in.
17149    /// The deeper guarantee (pinning survives a shard being retired and
17150    /// its slot recycled) is `Shard::drop`'s contract, tested directly in
17151    /// `shard.rs` where `is_current` and the pool's internals are
17152    /// accessible without going through `ShardPool::rotate`, which no
17153    /// longer has any path to actually recycle a slot (see its doc).
17154    #[test]
17155    fn test_pin_shards_returns_readable_deduped_handles() {
17156        let dir = test_dir("pin_shards_basic");
17157        let store = PackfileStorage::open(dir).unwrap();
17158
17159        let id = [0x77u8; 16];
17160        store
17161            .put(
17162                &TEST_COLLECTION,
17163                &id,
17164                &NodeData::new(bytes::Bytes::from_static(b"pin me")),
17165            )
17166            .unwrap();
17167        let (slot, offset) = store
17168            .generation(&TEST_COLLECTION)
17169            .unwrap()
17170            .index
17171            .lookup(&id)
17172            .expect("just-written record must be indexed");
17173
17174        // Duplicate ids in the input must collapse to one pinned entry.
17175        let pinned = store.pin_shards([slot, slot, slot].into_iter());
17176        assert_eq!(pinned.len(), 1);
17177
17178        let record = store
17179            .read_at(&pinned[&slot], offset, true)
17180            .expect("pinned shard must resolve the real on-disk record");
17181        assert_eq!(record.data.as_ref(), b"pin me");
17182    }

17184    /// NOTE: this test asserts a stronger property than the concurrent
17185    /// put+reachable-repack contract provides: every `put` that has returned
17186    /// remains present in a later repack output. A failure implies no
17187    /// data-loss or buffering bug — the durability/checkpoint machinery is
17188    /// not exercised here.
17189    ///
17190    /// An earlier revision of this comment documented a specific race (a put
17191    /// landing between the repack's scan boundary and its generation swap)
17192    /// and labelled the test KNOWN-FLAKY. That mechanism does not hold: both
17193    /// `put` and `repack_collection_reachable` hold the same
17194    /// `put_mutex(collection_id)` for their entire body, so a put cannot
17195    /// observe an in-progress repack at all. Re-investigation (55 runs,
17196    /// plain and under artificial CPU load) reproduced zero failures, and no
17197    /// panic output survives from the original reports, so the flakiness
17198    /// claim, its mechanism, and the "known-flaky" label are retracted as
17199    /// unconfirmed. If this test ever fails, the cause is the unchecked
17200    /// linearizability assumption above — investigate from that assertion,
17201    /// not from a presumed put/repack interleaving.
17202    #[test]
17203    fn test_concurrent_put_repack_reachable_no_lost_writes() {
17204        use std::thread;
17205
17206        let dir = test_dir("concurrent_put_repack_reachable");
17207        let store = PackfileStorage::open(dir).unwrap();
17208
17209        let collection = [0x66u8; 16];
17210        let written_count = std::sync::atomic::AtomicU32::new(0);
17211
17212        // No live roots configured, so the reachable repacker must fall
17213        // back to "preserve everything" — this proves that fallback holds
17214        // even when interleaved with concurrent writes.
17215        thread::scope(|scope| {
17216            let writer = scope.spawn(|| {
17217                for i in 0..200u32 {
17218                    let mut id = [0u8; 16];
17219                    id[0..4].copy_from_slice(&i.to_le_bytes());
17220                    let data = NodeData::new(bytes::Bytes::from(format!("entry {i}")));
17221                    store.put(&collection, &id, &data).unwrap();
17222                    written_count.fetch_add(1, std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed);
17223                }
17224            });
17225
17226            let repacker = scope.spawn(|| {
17227                for _ in 0..5 {
17228                    std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_micros(50));
17229                    let _ =
17230                        store.repack_collection_reachable(&collection, |_hash, _data| Vec::new());
17231                }
17232            });
17233
17234            writer.join().unwrap();
17235            repacker.join().unwrap();
17236        });
17237
17238        let total = written_count.load(std::sync::atomic::Ordering::Relaxed);
17239        let mut found = 0u32;
17240        for i in 0..total {
17241            let mut id = [0u8; 16];
17242            id[0..4].copy_from_slice(&i.to_le_bytes());
17243            if store.get(&collection, &id).unwrap().is_some() {
17244                found += 1;
17245            }
17246        }
17247
17248        assert_eq!(
17249            found, total,
17250            "lost writes during concurrent put+reachable-repack"
17251        );
17252    }
17253
17254    /// Collect the metadata of every record in every pack file under `dir`.
17255    fn all_record_metadata(dir: &std::path::Path) -> Vec<FrameMetadata> {
17256        use std::io::{Seek, SeekFrom};
17257
17258        let mut found = Vec::new();
17259        for entry in fs::read_dir(dir).unwrap() {
17260            let path = entry.unwrap().path();
17261            if path.extension().is_some_and(|ext| ext == "pack") {
17262                let mut file = fs::File::open(&path).unwrap();
17263                file.seek(SeekFrom::Start(packfile::HEADER_LEN as u64))
17264                    .unwrap();
17265                while let Some(record) = packfile::read_record_metadata(&mut file).unwrap() {
17266                    if let Some(metadata) = record.metadata {
17267                        found.push(metadata);
17268                    }
17269                }
17270            }
17271        }
17272        found
17273    }

17275    /// `put_verified` must reject a mismatched digest before writing anything,
17276    /// and accept a matching digest while attaching the full logical id,
17277    /// content digest, algorithm, and role to the on-disk frame.
17278    #[test]
17279    fn put_verified_checks_digest_and_attaches_metadata() {
17280        let dir = test_dir("put_verified_metadata");
17281        let store = PackfileStorage::open(dir.clone()).unwrap();
17282        let collection = [0x31; 16];
17283        let id = [0x32; 16];
17284        let payload = b"canonical event bytes";
17285        let data = NodeData::new(bytes::Bytes::from_static(payload));
17286        let logical_id = [0x77; 32];
17287        let digest = crate::storage::content_digest(DigestAlgorithm::Sha256, payload);
17288
17289        // A wrong expected digest is rejected and leaves no record behind.
17290        let mut wrong = digest;
17291        wrong[0] ^= 0xff;
17292        let error = store
17293            .put_verified(
17294                &collection,
17295                &id,
17296                &data,
17297                &logical_id,
17298                DigestAlgorithm::Sha256,
17299                &wrong,
17300                Some(b"event"),
17301            )
17302            .unwrap_err();
17303        assert!(matches!(error, StorageError::Corrupt(_)), "got {error:?}");
17304        assert!(store.get(&collection, &id).unwrap().is_none());
17305        assert_eq!(all_record_metadata(&dir), Vec::new());
17306
17307        // The matching digest succeeds.
17308        store
17309            .put_verified(
17310                &collection,
17311                &id,
17312                &data,
17313                &logical_id,
17314                DigestAlgorithm::Sha256,
17315                &digest,
17316                Some(b"event"),
17317            )
17318            .unwrap();
17319        store.sync().unwrap();
17320
17321        assert_eq!(
17322            store.get(&collection, &id).unwrap().map(|d| d.bytes),
17323            Some(bytes::Bytes::from_static(payload))
17324        );
17325
17326        let metadatas = all_record_metadata(&dir);
17327        assert_eq!(metadatas.len(), 1);
17328        let metadata = &metadatas[0];
17329        assert_eq!(metadata.logical_id, Some(logical_id));
17330        assert_eq!(metadata.content_digest, Some(digest));
17331        assert_eq!(metadata.digest_algorithm, DigestAlgorithm::Sha256);
17332        assert_eq!(metadata.role.as_deref(), Some(&b"event"[..]));
17333
17334        // Read path reconstructs metadata too (via `read_record_metadata`).
17335        drop(store);
17336        let reopened = PackfileStorage::open(dir.clone()).unwrap();
17337        assert_eq!(
17338            reopened.get(&collection, &id).unwrap().map(|d| d.bytes),
17339            Some(bytes::Bytes::from_static(payload))
17340        );
17341        drop(reopened);
17342        fs::remove_dir_all(&dir).ok();
17343    }

17423    /// Concurrent genesis establishment on a real packfile-backed store must
17424    /// serialize on the collection `put_mutex`: without it, two writers can
17425    /// both observe an absent metadata record and append conflicting genesis
17426    /// frames. `InMemoryStorage`'s equivalent is trivially serialized by its
17427    /// single map write lock; this exercises the locking path that is not.
17428    ///
17429    /// Scope: intra-process only. The `put_mutex` map is per-instance, so it
17430    /// says nothing about writers in separate processes. Cross-process writers
17431    /// are excluded by the shard pool's exclusive `.mtxdb.lock` writer lock
17432    /// (`ShardPool::acquire_writer_lock`), which permits one writer process per
17433    /// store; this test pins the thread-level race.
17434    #[test]
17435    fn ensure_collection_metadata_is_atomic_under_concurrency() {
17436        use crate::template::{
17437            derive_collection_id, CollectionMetadata, FrameIdPolicy, PayloadPolicy,
17438            RecordIdentityRule,
17439        };
17440
17441        let dir = test_dir("ensure_metadata_concurrent");
17442        let store = Arc::new(PackfileStorage::open(dir.clone()).unwrap());
17443        let metadata = Arc::new(CollectionMetadata {
17444            member_namespace: Some(*b"EVNT"),
17445            collection_canonical_id: b"!room:matrix.org".to_vec(),
17446            record_id_rule: RecordIdentityRule {
17447                policy: FrameIdPolicy::Pointer {
17448                    pointer: "/event_id".into(),
17449                },
17450                digest_algorithm: DigestAlgorithm::Sha256,
17451            },
17452            payload: PayloadPolicy::Source,
17453            extension: None,
17454            role: None,
17455            schema: None,
17456        });
17457        let collection =
17458            derive_collection_id(metadata.member_namespace, &metadata.collection_canonical_id);
17459
17460        // Release every thread at once so the lookup/append windows overlap.
17461        let barrier = Arc::new(std::sync::Barrier::new(8));
17462        let handles: Vec<_> = (0..8)
17463            .map(|_| {
17464                let store = Arc::clone(&store);
17465                let metadata = Arc::clone(&metadata);
17466                let barrier = Arc::clone(&barrier);
17467                std::thread::spawn(move || {
17468                    barrier.wait();
17469                    store
17470                        .ensure_collection_metadata(&collection, &metadata)
17471                        .expect("concurrent genesis establishment must be idempotent");
17472                })
17473            })
17474            .collect();
17475        for handle in handles {
17476            handle.join().unwrap();
17477        }
17478
17479        assert_eq!(
17480            store.get_collection_metadata(&collection).unwrap(),
17481            Some((*metadata).clone())
17482        );
17483        assert_eq!(store.collection_len(&collection).unwrap(), Some(1));
17484        drop(store);
17485        fs::remove_dir_all(&dir).ok();
17486    }
17487
17488    /// Writers racing with *different* genesis metadata must not both win:
17489    /// exactly one establishes the collection and every other writer sees the
17490    /// mismatch. Without the collection's `put_mutex` held across the lookup
17491    /// and append, several writers could each append their own genesis frame.
17492    #[test]
17493    fn ensure_collection_metadata_conflicting_writers_have_one_winner() {
17494        use crate::template::{
17495            derive_collection_id, CollectionMetadata, FrameIdPolicy, PayloadPolicy,
17496            RecordIdentityRule,
17497        };
17498
17499        let dir = test_dir("ensure_metadata_conflict");
17500        let store = Arc::new(PackfileStorage::open(dir.clone()).unwrap());
17501        let collection = derive_collection_id(Some(*b"EVNT"), b"!room:matrix.org");
17502        let candidates: Vec<CollectionMetadata> = (0..8)
17503            .map(|i| CollectionMetadata {
17504                member_namespace: Some(*b"EVNT"),
17505                collection_canonical_id: b"!room:matrix.org".to_vec(),
17506                record_id_rule: RecordIdentityRule {
17507                    policy: FrameIdPolicy::Pointer {
17508                        pointer: "/event_id".into(),
17509                    },
17510                    digest_algorithm: DigestAlgorithm::Sha256,
17511                },
17512                payload: PayloadPolicy::Source,
17513                extension: None,
17514                role: Some(format!("role_{i}")),
17515                schema: None,
17516            })
17517            .collect();
17518
17519        let barrier = Arc::new(std::sync::Barrier::new(candidates.len()));
17520        let results: Vec<_> = std::thread::scope(|scope| {
17521            let handles: Vec<_> = candidates
17522                .iter()
17523                .map(|metadata| {
17524                    let store = Arc::clone(&store);
17525                    let barrier = Arc::clone(&barrier);
17526                    scope.spawn(move || {
17527                        barrier.wait();
17528                        store.ensure_collection_metadata(&collection, metadata)
17529                    })
17530                })
17531                .collect();
17532            handles.into_iter().map(|h| h.join().unwrap()).collect()
17533        });
17534
17535        assert_eq!(
17536            results.iter().filter(|r| r.is_ok()).count(),
17537            1,
17538            "exactly one conflicting genesis writer may succeed: {results:?}"
17539        );
17540        for result in results.iter().filter(|r| r.is_err()) {
17541            assert!(
17542                matches!(result, Err(StorageError::Internal(msg)) if msg.contains("mismatch")),
17543                "losers must report a metadata mismatch, got {result:?}"
17544            );
17545        }
17546        let stored = store
17547            .get_collection_metadata(&collection)
17548            .unwrap()
17549            .expect("the winner's genesis record is stored");
17550        assert!(candidates.contains(&stored));
17551        assert_eq!(store.collection_len(&collection).unwrap(), Some(1));
17552        drop(store);
17553        fs::remove_dir_all(&dir).ok();
17554    }

17556    /// Checkpoint-backed hash recovery must handle frames that carry metadata
17557    /// (as `put_verified` writes do). `record_identity_at` previously rejected
17558    /// `FLAG_METADATA` frames, so `grow_checkpoint_index` failed closed to a
17559    /// full rescan instead of recovering their identity.
17560    #[test]
17561    fn checkpoint_growth_recovers_metadata_bearing_frames() {
17562        let dir = test_dir("checkpoint_growth_metadata");
17563        let collection = TEST_COLLECTION;
17564        let id = [0x33u8; 16];
17565        let payload = bytes::Bytes::from_static(b"metadata payload");
17566        let digest = DigestAlgorithm::Sha256.digest(&payload);
17567
17568        let store = PackfileStorage::open(dir.clone()).unwrap();
17569        store
17570            .put_verified(
17571                &collection,
17572                &id,
17573                &NodeData::new(payload),
17574                &digest,
17575                DigestAlgorithm::Sha256,
17576                &digest,
17577                None,
17578            )
17579            .unwrap();
17580        store.sync_all().unwrap();
17581        drop(store);
17582
17583        let reopened = PackfileStorage::open(dir.clone()).unwrap();
17584        let checkpoint_index = reopened
17585            .generation(&collection)
17586            .expect("checkpoint collection exists");
17587        assert!(checkpoint_index.index.is_mmap_backed());
17588        let grown = reopened
17589            .grow_checkpoint_index(&collection, &checkpoint_index.index)
17590            .unwrap()
17591            .expect("checkpoint index can grow");
17592        assert!(
17593            grown.lookup(&id).is_some(),
17594            "a metadata-bearing frame's identity must be recoverable"
17595        );
17596        drop(checkpoint_index);
17597        drop(reopened);
17598        fs::remove_dir_all(&dir).ok();
17599    }

17601    /// Two stores attached to one shared coordinator: a single pool's sync
17602    /// commits both pools' published mutations in one durability barrier, and
17603    /// a later reopen replays only each pool's own tagged frames.
17604    #[test]
17605    #[cfg(feature = "multi-reader")]
17606    fn shared_journal_fences_all_pools_and_routes_replay_by_pool() {
17607        use crate::journal::{Journal, JournalCoordinator};
17608        use crate::layout::ShardType;
17609
17610        let root = test_dir("shared_journal_root");
17611        let dir_a = test_dir("shared_journal_a");
17612        let dir_b = test_dir("shared_journal_b");
17613        let wal = root.join("wal.bin");
17614
17615        let coordinator = Arc::new({
17616            let (journal, scan) = Journal::open_shared(&wal).unwrap();
17617            JournalCoordinator::new(journal, &scan)
17618        });
17619
17620        let a = PackfileStorage::open(dir_a.clone()).unwrap();
17621        let b = PackfileStorage::open(dir_b.clone()).unwrap();
17622        a.enable_shared_journal(Arc::clone(&coordinator), ShardType::State)
17623            .unwrap();
17624        b.enable_shared_journal(Arc::clone(&coordinator), ShardType::EventDag)
17625            .unwrap();
17626
17627        a.put(
17628            &TEST_COLLECTION,
17629            &distinct_id(0),
17630            &NodeData::new(bytes::Bytes::from_static(b"state")),
17631        )
17632        .unwrap();
17633        b.put(
17634            &OTHER_COLLECTION,
17635            &distinct_id(1),
17636            &NodeData::new(bytes::Bytes::from_static(b"event")),
17637        )
17638        .unwrap();
17639
17640        // One durability barrier fences the other pool's published mutation
17641        // too, without checkpointing either pool and triggering reclaim.
17642        coordinator.sync().unwrap();
17643        assert_eq!(
17644            coordinator.committed_lsn(),
17645            coordinator.published_lsn(),
17646            "one barrier must commit every pool's published mutation"
17647        );
17648        // A fresh session over the shared segment: each autocommit write is
17649        // its own complete group; one fsync covered both.
17650        let (journal, scan) = Journal::open_shared(&wal).unwrap();
17651        assert_eq!(scan.groups.len(), 2, "one group per autocommit write");
17652        assert_eq!(scan.groups[0].entries.len(), 1);
17653        assert_eq!(scan.groups[1].entries.len(), 1);
17654        let recovered = Arc::new(JournalCoordinator::new(journal, &scan));
17655
17656        let fresh_a = PackfileStorage::open(test_dir("shared_journal_fresh_a")).unwrap();
17657        fresh_a
17658            .enable_shared_journal(Arc::clone(&recovered), ShardType::State)
17659            .unwrap();
17660        assert_eq!(
17661            fresh_a.replay_journal().unwrap(),
17662            1,
17663            "the state store replays only its own pool's frame"
17664        );
17665        assert!(fresh_a
17666            .get(&TEST_COLLECTION, &distinct_id(0))
17667            .unwrap()
17668            .is_some());
17669        assert!(
17670            fresh_a
17671                .get(&OTHER_COLLECTION, &distinct_id(1))
17672                .unwrap()
17673                .is_none(),
17674            "a pool must not replay another pool's frames"
17675        );
17676
17677        let fresh_b = PackfileStorage::open(test_dir("shared_journal_fresh_b")).unwrap();
17678        fresh_b
17679            .enable_shared_journal(Arc::clone(&recovered), ShardType::EventDag)
17680            .unwrap();
17681        assert_eq!(fresh_b.replay_journal().unwrap(), 1);
17682        assert!(fresh_b
17683            .get(&OTHER_COLLECTION, &distinct_id(1))
17684            .unwrap()
17685            .is_some());
17686        assert!(fresh_b
17687            .get(&TEST_COLLECTION, &distinct_id(0))
17688            .unwrap()
17689            .is_none());
17690        drop(fresh_a);
17691        drop(fresh_b);
17692        drop(a);
17693        drop(b);
17694    }

17696    /// A single-pool autocommit group can be reclaimed on its own once its
17697    /// pool checkpoints: a reopen replays only the surviving frames, and LSNs
17698    /// continue past the reclaimed prefix without being reused.
17699    #[test]
17700    #[cfg(feature = "multi-reader")]
17701    fn shared_reclaim_of_a_single_pool_group_then_reopen_replays_the_rest() {
17702        use crate::journal::{Journal, JournalCoordinator};
17703        use crate::layout::ShardType;
17704
17705        let root = test_dir("shared_reclaim_replay_root");
17706        let wal = root.join("wal.bin");
17707        let coordinator = Arc::new({
17708            let (journal, scan) = Journal::open_shared(&wal).unwrap();
17709            JournalCoordinator::new(journal, &scan)
17710        });
17711        let a = PackfileStorage::open(test_dir("shared_reclaim_replay_a")).unwrap();
17712        let b = PackfileStorage::open(test_dir("shared_reclaim_replay_b")).unwrap();
17713        a.enable_shared_journal(Arc::clone(&coordinator), ShardType::State)
17714            .unwrap();
17715        b.enable_shared_journal(Arc::clone(&coordinator), ShardType::EventDag)
17716            .unwrap();
17717
17718        // LSN 1 is State's; LSNs 2 and 3 are EventDag's. Each autocommit
17719        // write is its own group.
17720        a.put(
17721            &TEST_COLLECTION,
17722            &distinct_id(0),
17723            &NodeData::new(bytes::Bytes::from_static(b"state")),
17724        )
17725        .unwrap();
17726        for id in [1u8, 2] {
17727            b.put(
17728                &OTHER_COLLECTION,
17729                &distinct_id(id),
17730                &NodeData::new(bytes::Bytes::from_static(b"event")),
17731            )
17732            .unwrap();
17733        }
17734        coordinator.sync().unwrap();
17735        assert_eq!(coordinator.committed_lsn(), 3);
17736
17737        // State checkpoints through its own frame; EventDag has not. Only the
17738        // covered single-pool group may be reclaimed.
17739        coordinator.report_pool_coverage(ShardType::State, 1);
17740        assert!(coordinator.reclaim_shared().unwrap().is_some());
17741        drop(a);
17742        drop(b);
17743        drop(coordinator);
17744
17745        let (journal, scan) = Journal::open_shared(&wal).unwrap();
17746        assert_eq!(scan.base_lsn, 2, "the state group is reclaimed");
17747        assert_eq!(scan.groups.len(), 2, "both uncovered event groups survive");
17748        assert_eq!(scan.groups[0].first_lsn, 2);
17749        let recovered = Arc::new(JournalCoordinator::new(journal, &scan));
17750
17751        // The reclaimed state frame is gone from the journal by design: its
17752        // pool's checkpoint owns it, so a state store has nothing to replay.
17753        let fresh_a = PackfileStorage::open(test_dir("shared_reclaim_replay_fresh_a")).unwrap();
17754        fresh_a
17755            .enable_shared_journal(Arc::clone(&recovered), ShardType::State)
17756            .unwrap();
17757        assert_eq!(fresh_a.replay_journal().unwrap(), 0);
17758
17759        // The event store replays exactly the frames that survived.
17760        let fresh_b = PackfileStorage::open(test_dir("shared_reclaim_replay_fresh_b")).unwrap();
17761        fresh_b
17762            .enable_shared_journal(Arc::clone(&recovered), ShardType::EventDag)
17763            .unwrap();
17764        assert_eq!(fresh_b.replay_journal().unwrap(), 2);
17765        for id in [1u8, 2] {
17766            assert!(fresh_b
17767                .get(&OTHER_COLLECTION, &distinct_id(id))
17768                .unwrap()
17769                .is_some());
17770        }
17771
17772        // Numbering continues past the reclaimed prefix: no LSN is reused.
17773        fresh_b
17774            .put(
17775                &OTHER_COLLECTION,
17776                &distinct_id(3),
17777                &NodeData::new(bytes::Bytes::from_static(b"event")),
17778            )
17779            .unwrap();
17780        assert_eq!(recovered.published_lsn(), 4);
17781        drop(fresh_a);
17782        drop(fresh_b);
17783    }

17785    /// A shared segment may only be reclaimed up to the minimum durable
17786    /// coverage across every pool that has frames in it.
17787    #[test]
17788    #[cfg(feature = "multi-reader")]
17789    fn shared_reclaim_waits_for_every_pool_then_truncates() {
17790        use crate::journal::{Journal, JournalCoordinator};
17791        use crate::layout::ShardType;
17792
17793        let root = test_dir("shared_reclaim_root");
17794        let dir_a = test_dir("shared_reclaim_a");
17795        let dir_b = test_dir("shared_reclaim_b");
17796        let wal = root.join("wal.bin");
17797
17798        let coordinator = Arc::new({
17799            let (journal, scan) = Journal::open_shared(&wal).unwrap();
17800            JournalCoordinator::new(journal, &scan)
17801        });
17802
17803        let a = PackfileStorage::open(dir_a.clone()).unwrap();
17804        let b = PackfileStorage::open(dir_b.clone()).unwrap();
17805        a.enable_shared_journal(Arc::clone(&coordinator), ShardType::State)
17806            .unwrap();
17807        b.enable_shared_journal(Arc::clone(&coordinator), ShardType::EventDag)
17808            .unwrap();
17809
17810        a.put(
17811            &TEST_COLLECTION,
17812            &distinct_id(0),
17813            &NodeData::new(bytes::Bytes::from_static(b"a")),
17814        )
17815        .unwrap();
17816        b.put(
17817            &OTHER_COLLECTION,
17818            &distinct_id(1),
17819            &NodeData::new(bytes::Bytes::from_static(b"b")),
17820        )
17821        .unwrap();
17822
17823        // Only A checkpoints; B still has an un-covered frame in the segment,
17824        // so the shared prefix must not be reclaimed yet.
17825        a.sync_all().unwrap();
17826        assert_eq!(
17827            Journal::scan_read_only(&wal).unwrap().groups.len(),
17828            1,
17829            "shared reclaim must wait for every pool's coverage"
17830        );
17831
17832        // B checkpoints too; now the covered prefix can be dropped.
17833        b.sync_all().unwrap();
17834        let scan = Journal::scan_read_only(&wal).unwrap();
17835        assert_eq!(scan.groups.len(), 0, "every pool covered: prefix reclaimed");
17836        assert!(
17837            scan.base_lsn > 1,
17838            "the segment base advanced past the reclaimed group"
17839        );
17840    }

17842    /// End-to-end: three interleaved pool groups, independent per-pool
17843    /// checkpoints, shared reclaim, then a read-only reopen. The state reader's
17844    /// index boundary is state's own watermark, so a base advanced by the
17845    /// event-DAG pool must not be mistaken for a lost state frame.
17846    #[test]
17847    #[cfg(feature = "multi-reader")]
17848    fn shared_interleaved_checkpoints_reclaim_then_read_only_reopen() {
17849        use crate::journal::{Journal, JournalCoordinator};
17850        use crate::layout::ShardType;
17851
17852        let root = test_dir("shared_e2e_root");
17853        let dir_state = test_dir("shared_e2e_state");
17854        let dir_event = test_dir("shared_e2e_event");
17855        let wal = root.join("wal.bin");
17856
17857        let coordinator = Arc::new({
17858            let (journal, scan) = Journal::open_shared(&wal).unwrap();
17859            JournalCoordinator::new(journal, &scan)
17860        });
17861
17862        let state = PackfileStorage::open(dir_state.clone()).unwrap();
17863        let event = PackfileStorage::open(dir_event.clone()).unwrap();
17864        state
17865            .enable_shared_journal(Arc::clone(&coordinator), ShardType::State)
17866            .unwrap();
17867        event
17868            .enable_shared_journal(Arc::clone(&coordinator), ShardType::EventDag)
17869            .unwrap();
17870
17871        // Interleaved commits: each sync checkpoints only its own pool.
17872        state
17873            .put(
17874                &TEST_COLLECTION,
17875                &distinct_id(0),
17876                &NodeData::new(bytes::Bytes::from_static(b"state-1")),
17877            )
17878            .unwrap();
17879        state.sync_all().unwrap();
17880        event
17881            .put(
17882                &OTHER_COLLECTION,
17883                &distinct_id(1),
17884                &NodeData::new(bytes::Bytes::from_static(b"event-1")),
17885            )
17886            .unwrap();
17887        event.sync_all().unwrap();
17888        state
17889            .put(
17890                &TEST_COLLECTION,
17891                &distinct_id(2),
17892                &NodeData::new(bytes::Bytes::from_static(b"state-2")),
17893            )
17894            .unwrap();
17895        state.sync_all().unwrap();
17896        // Force a full rewrite so this test exercises reclaim deterministically
17897        // (an ordinary sync may append a delta instead).
17898        state.force_index_checkpoint().unwrap();
17899
17900        // The two pools have distinct watermarks. Each pool's group is
17901        // reclaimed as soon as that pool has checkpointed it: state's later
17902        // group does not wait on event-DAG, whose frames never reached it.
17903        let state_lsn = coordinator.committed_lsn_for_pool(ShardType::State);
17904        let event_lsn = coordinator.committed_lsn_for_pool(ShardType::EventDag);
17905        assert!(state_lsn > event_lsn, "state committed a later group");
17906        let scan = Journal::scan_read_only(&wal).unwrap();
17907        assert!(
17908            scan.groups.is_empty(),
17909            "each pool's own group is reclaimed once that pool covers it"
17910        );
17911        assert_eq!(
17912            scan.base_lsn,
17913            state_lsn + 1,
17914            "an idle pool must not pin a later group its frames never reached"
17915        );
17916
17917        drop(state);
17918        drop(event);
17919
17920        // Read-only reopen of the state pool: its checkpoint covered exactly
17921        // its own watermark, so the reclaimed prefix is not a coverage gap and
17922        // the durable records remain readable.
17923        let reader = PackfileStorage::open_read_only(dir_state.clone()).unwrap();
17924        reader
17925            .enable_read_journal_shared(&wal, ShardType::State)
17926            .unwrap();
17927        let got = reader
17928            .get_read_committed(&TEST_COLLECTION, &[distinct_id(0), distinct_id(2)])
17929            .unwrap();
17930        assert_eq!(
17931            got[0].as_ref().map(|data| data.bytes.as_ref()),
17932            Some(&b"state-1"[..])
17933        );
17934        assert_eq!(
17935            got[1].as_ref().map(|data| data.bytes.as_ref()),
17936            Some(&b"state-2"[..])
17937        );
17938    }
17939
17940    /// A shared reader whose own frame was committed by another pool's sync
17941    /// (so its checkpoint has not advanced) must tolerate a base LSN gap opened
17942    /// entirely by the other pools and read its own frame, instead of failing
17943    /// closed on the reclaim.
17944    #[test]
17945    #[cfg(feature = "multi-reader")]
17946    fn shared_read_committed_accepts_another_pools_reclaimed_prefix() {
17947        use crate::journal::{Journal, JournalCoordinator};
17948        use crate::layout::ShardType;
17949
17950        let root = test_dir("shared_gap_root");
17951        let dir_state = test_dir("shared_gap_state");
17952        let dir_event = test_dir("shared_gap_event");
17953        let wal = root.join("wal.bin");
17954
17955        let coordinator = Arc::new({
17956            let (journal, scan) = Journal::open_shared(&wal).unwrap();
17957            JournalCoordinator::new(journal, &scan)
17958        });
17959        let state = PackfileStorage::open(dir_state.clone()).unwrap();
17960        let event = PackfileStorage::open(dir_event.clone()).unwrap();
17961        state
17962            .enable_shared_journal(Arc::clone(&coordinator), ShardType::State)
17963            .unwrap();
17964        event
17965            .enable_shared_journal(Arc::clone(&coordinator), ShardType::EventDag)
17966            .unwrap();
17967
17968        // State checkpoints one frame, then the reader opens bound to it.
17969        state
17970            .put(
17971                &TEST_COLLECTION,
17972                &distinct_id(0),
17973                &NodeData::new(bytes::Bytes::from_static(b"state-1")),
17974            )
17975            .unwrap();
17976        state.sync_all().unwrap();
17977        state.force_index_checkpoint().unwrap();
17978        let reader = PackfileStorage::open_read_only(dir_state.clone()).unwrap();
17979        reader
17980            .enable_read_journal_shared(&wal, ShardType::State)
17981            .unwrap();
17982
17983        // Event-DAG reclaims its own later groups, advancing the segment base
17984        // well past the reader's coverage without ever moving state's.
17985        for id in 1..4u8 {
17986            event
17987                .put(
17988                    &OTHER_COLLECTION,
17989                    &distinct_id(id),
17990                    &NodeData::new(bytes::Bytes::from_static(b"event")),
17991                )
17992                .unwrap();
17993            event.sync_all().unwrap();
17994            event.force_index_checkpoint().unwrap();
17995        }
17996
17997        // State publishes a second frame; event's sync commits it, but state
17998        // never checkpoints, so state's durable coverage stays at the first
17999        // frame while the frame now sits above the advanced base.
18000        state
18001            .put(
18002                &TEST_COLLECTION,
18003                &distinct_id(9),
18004                &NodeData::new(bytes::Bytes::from_static(b"state-2")),
18005            )
18006            .unwrap();
18007        event.sync_all().unwrap();
18008
18009        let got = reader
18010            .get_read_committed(&TEST_COLLECTION, &[distinct_id(9)])
18011            .expect("a base gap made of other pools' frames must not fail closed");
18012        assert_eq!(
18013            got[0].as_ref().map(|data| data.bytes.as_ref()),
18014            Some(&b"state-2"[..])
18015        );
18016        assert_eq!(
18017            reader
18018                .get_read_committed(&TEST_COLLECTION, &[distinct_id(0)])
18019                .unwrap()[0]
18020                .as_ref()
18021                .map(|data| data.bytes.as_ref()),
18022            Some(&b"state-1"[..]),
18023            "the reader's own checkpointed frame must remain readable"
18024        );
18025    }
18026
18027    /// A read-only worker on a shared WAL must observe only its own pool's
18028    /// tagged frames, not the other pools' interleaved in the same segment.
18029    #[test]
18030    #[cfg(feature = "multi-reader")]
18031    fn shared_read_committed_filters_by_pool() {
18032        use crate::journal::{Journal, JournalCoordinator};
18033        use crate::layout::ShardType;
18034
18035        let root = test_dir("shared_read_committed_root");
18036        let wal = root.join("wal.bin");
18037        let (journal, scan) = Journal::open_shared(&wal).unwrap();
18038        let coordinator = JournalCoordinator::new(journal, &scan);
18039        coordinator
18040            .publish_group_tagged(
18041                ShardType::State,
18042                &[JournalMutation::Put {
18043                    collection_id: TEST_COLLECTION,
18044                    node_id: distinct_id(0),
18045                    payload: b"state".to_vec(),
18046                }],
18047            )
18048            .unwrap();
18049        coordinator
18050            .publish_group_tagged(
18051                ShardType::EventDag,
18052                &[JournalMutation::Put {
18053                    collection_id: OTHER_COLLECTION,
18054                    node_id: distinct_id(1),
18055                    payload: b"event".to_vec(),
18056                }],
18057            )
18058            .unwrap();
18059        coordinator.sync().unwrap();
18060        drop(coordinator);
18061
18062        // A read-only open needs at least one shard, so seed each reader's own
18063        // pool directory with a durable record in an unrelated collection.
18064        let seed_dir = |name: &str| {
18065            let dir = test_dir(name);
18066            {
18067                let seed = PackfileStorage::open(dir.clone()).unwrap();
18068                seed.put(
18069                    &[0x77; 16],
18070                    &distinct_id(9),
18071                    &NodeData::new(bytes::Bytes::from_static(b"seed")),
18072                )
18073                .unwrap();
18074                seed.sync_all().unwrap();
18075            }
18076            dir
18077        };
18078
18079        let state_reader = PackfileStorage::open_read_committed_shared(
18080            seed_dir("shared_read_committed_state"),
18081            &wal,
18082            ShardType::State,
18083        )
18084        .unwrap();
18085        assert!(
18086            state_reader
18087                .get_read_committed(&TEST_COLLECTION, &[distinct_id(0)])
18088                .unwrap()[0]
18089                .is_some(),
18090            "the state worker must see its own pool's frame"
18091        );
18092        assert!(
18093            state_reader
18094                .get_read_committed(&OTHER_COLLECTION, &[distinct_id(1)])
18095                .unwrap()[0]
18096                .is_none(),
18097            "the state worker must not see the event-DAG pool's frame"
18098        );
18099
18100        let event_reader = PackfileStorage::open_read_committed_shared(
18101            seed_dir("shared_read_committed_event"),
18102            &wal,
18103            ShardType::EventDag,
18104        )
18105        .unwrap();
18106        assert!(event_reader
18107            .get_read_committed(&OTHER_COLLECTION, &[distinct_id(1)])
18108            .unwrap()[0]
18109            .is_some());
18110        assert!(event_reader
18111            .get_read_committed(&TEST_COLLECTION, &[distinct_id(0)])
18112            .unwrap()[0]
18113            .is_none());
18114    }

18116    /// The root shared-WAL lock is exclusive while held and reacquirable after
18117    /// the holder drops it.
18118    #[test]
18119    #[cfg(feature = "multi-reader")]
18120    fn shared_wal_lock_is_exclusive() {
18121        let root = test_dir("shared_wal_lock_exclusive");
18122        // A shared-WAL lock is gated on a shared-layout database descriptor.
18123        let _layout = crate::layout::DatabaseLayout::open(root.clone()).unwrap();
18124        let first = crate::journal::SharedWalLock::acquire(&root).unwrap();
18125        let second = crate::journal::SharedWalLock::acquire(&root);
18126        assert!(
18127            matches!(second, Err(ref error) if error.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::WouldBlock),
18128            "a second writer must be refused while the root lock is held"
18129        );
18130        drop(first);
18131        assert!(
18132            crate::journal::SharedWalLock::acquire(&root).is_ok(),
18133            "a released root lock must be reacquirable"
18134        );
18135    }

18137    #[test]
18138    #[allow(clippy::too_many_lines)]
18139    fn packfile_storage_create_or_upsert_established_validated_contract() {
18140        use crate::template::{
18141            derive_collection_id, CollectionMetadata, FrameIdPolicy, PayloadPolicy,
18142            RecordIdentityRule, MEMBER_NAMESPACE_INTL,
18143        };
18144
18145        let dir = test_dir("create_or_upsert_contract");
18146        let store = PackfileStorage::open(dir.clone()).unwrap();
18147
18148        let canonical_id = b"sys:packfile-upsert";
18149        let col_id = derive_collection_id(Some(MEMBER_NAMESPACE_INTL), canonical_id);
18150
18151        let valid_meta = CollectionMetadata {
18152            member_namespace: Some(MEMBER_NAMESPACE_INTL),
18153            collection_canonical_id: canonical_id.to_vec(),
18154            record_id_rule: RecordIdentityRule {
18155                policy: FrameIdPolicy::Key,
18156                digest_algorithm: DigestAlgorithm::Blake3,
18157            },
18158            payload: PayloadPolicy::Source,
18159            extension: None,
18160            role: Some("system_auxiliary".to_owned()),
18161            schema: None,
18162        };
18163
18164        let node_id = [0x55; 16];
18165        let data1 = NodeData::new(bytes::Bytes::from_static(b"val1"));
18166
18167        // 1. Validation failure on absent collection leaves collection absent
18168        let err = store
18169            .create_or_upsert_established_validated(
18170                &col_id,
18171                &valid_meta,
18172                &node_id,
18173                &data1,
18174                &mut |_| Err(StorageError::Internal("pre-check failed".into())),
18175            )
18176            .unwrap_err();
18177        assert!(matches!(err, StorageError::Internal(_)));
18178        assert!(!store.collection_exists(&col_id));
18179        assert!(store.get_collection_metadata(&col_id).unwrap().is_none());
18180        assert!(store.get(&col_id, &node_id).unwrap().is_none());
18181
18182        // 2. Successful establishment commits metadata and record atomically
18183        store
18184            .create_or_upsert_established_validated(
18185                &col_id,
18186                &valid_meta,
18187                &node_id,
18188                &data1,
18189                &mut |existing| {
18190                    assert!(existing.is_none());
18191                    Ok(())
18192                },
18193            )
18194            .unwrap();
18195        assert!(store.collection_exists(&col_id));
18196        assert_eq!(
18197            store.get_collection_metadata(&col_id).unwrap().unwrap(),
18198            valid_meta
18199        );
18200        assert_eq!(
18201            store.get(&col_id, &node_id).unwrap().unwrap().bytes,
18202            b"val1"[..]
18203        );
18204
18205        // 3. Idempotent retry: same key + same payload -> Ok(())
18206        let mut ran = false;
18207        store
18208            .create_or_upsert_established_validated(
18209                &col_id,
18210                &valid_meta,
18211                &node_id,
18212                &data1,
18213                &mut |existing| {
18214                    ran = true;
18215                    assert_eq!(existing.unwrap().bytes, b"val1"[..]);
18216                    Ok(())
18217                },
18218            )
18219            .unwrap();
18220        assert!(ran);
18221
18222        // 4. Same key replacement succeeds with new value
18223        let data2 = NodeData::new(bytes::Bytes::from_static(b"val2_updated"));
18224        store
18225            .create_or_upsert_established_validated(
18226                &col_id,
18227                &valid_meta,
18228                &node_id,
18229                &data2,
18230                &mut |existing| {
18231                    assert_eq!(existing.unwrap().bytes, b"val1"[..]);
18232                    Ok(())
18233                },
18234            )
18235            .unwrap();
18236        assert_eq!(
18237            store.get(&col_id, &node_id).unwrap().unwrap().bytes,
18238            b"val2_updated"[..]
18239        );
18240
18241        // 5. Collision detected by validator aborts without mutating
18242        let data3 = NodeData::new(bytes::Bytes::from_static(b"val3_conflict"));
18243        let err = store
18244            .create_or_upsert_established_validated(
18245                &col_id,
18246                &valid_meta,
18247                &node_id,
18248                &data3,
18249                &mut |existing| {
18250                    assert_eq!(existing.unwrap().bytes, b"val2_updated"[..]);
18251                    Err(StorageError::Collision("logical key collision".into()))
18252                },
18253            )
18254            .unwrap_err();
18255        assert!(matches!(err, StorageError::Collision(_)));
18256        assert_eq!(
18257            store.get(&col_id, &node_id).unwrap().unwrap().bytes,
18258            b"val2_updated"[..]
18259        );
18260
18261        // 6. Persistence across reopen
18262        drop(store);
18263        let reopened = PackfileStorage::open(dir).unwrap();
18264        assert_eq!(
18265            reopened.get_collection_metadata(&col_id).unwrap().unwrap(),
18266            valid_meta
18267        );
18268        assert_eq!(
18269            reopened.get(&col_id, &node_id).unwrap().unwrap().bytes,
18270            b"val2_updated"[..]
18271        );
18272
18273        // 7. Corrupted stored metadata detection: stored canonical id does not reproduce collection id
18274        let meta_colliding = CollectionMetadata {
18275            collection_canonical_id: b"sys:packfile-other".to_vec(),
18276            ..valid_meta.clone()
18277        };
18278        let target_col_id = derive_collection_id(
18279            meta_colliding.member_namespace,
18280            &meta_colliding.collection_canonical_id,
18281        );
18282        let sim_dir = test_dir("create_or_upsert_collision");
18283        let sim_store = PackfileStorage::open(sim_dir).unwrap();
18284        let seed = [(
18285            COLLECTION_METADATA_RECORD_ID,
18286            NodeData::new(valid_meta.encode().into()),
18287        )];
18288        sim_store
18289            .put_many_internal_locked(&target_col_id, &seed, None)
18290            .unwrap();
18291
18292        let err = sim_store
18293            .create_or_upsert_established_validated(
18294                &target_col_id,
18295                &meta_colliding,
18296                &node_id,
18297                &data1,
18298                &mut |_| Ok(()),
18299            )
18300            .unwrap_err();
18301        assert!(matches!(err, StorageError::Internal(_)));
18302
18303        // 8. Unknown member namespace rejected on establishment
18304        let meta_unknown = CollectionMetadata {
18305            member_namespace: Some(*b"EDGE"),
18306            ..valid_meta.clone()
18307        };
18308        let err_unknown = sim_store
18309            .create_or_upsert_established_validated(
18310                &target_col_id,
18311                &meta_unknown,
18312                &node_id,
18313                &data1,
18314                &mut |_| Ok(()),
18315            )
18316            .unwrap_err();
18317        assert!(matches!(err_unknown, StorageError::Internal(_)));
18318    }

18320    #[test]
18321    fn packfile_storage_create_or_upsert_concurrent_writers() {
18322        use crate::template::{
18323            derive_collection_id, CollectionMetadata, FrameIdPolicy, PayloadPolicy,
18324            RecordIdentityRule, MEMBER_NAMESPACE_INTL,
18325        };
18326
18327        let dir = test_dir("create_or_upsert_concurrency");
18328        let store = Arc::new(PackfileStorage::open(dir).unwrap());
18329
18330        let canonical_id = b"sys:concurrent-upsert";
18331        let col_id = derive_collection_id(Some(MEMBER_NAMESPACE_INTL), canonical_id);
18332
18333        let meta = CollectionMetadata {
18334            member_namespace: Some(MEMBER_NAMESPACE_INTL),
18335            collection_canonical_id: canonical_id.to_vec(),
18336            record_id_rule: RecordIdentityRule {
18337                policy: FrameIdPolicy::Key,
18338                digest_algorithm: DigestAlgorithm::Blake3,
18339            },
18340            payload: PayloadPolicy::Source,
18341            extension: None,
18342            role: Some("system_auxiliary".to_owned()),
18343            schema: None,
18344        };
18345
18346        let node_id = [0x77; 16];
18347        let barrier = Arc::new(std::sync::Barrier::new(2));
18348
18349        // Two threads race to write distinct keys sharing the same physical node_id
18350        let t1 = {
18351            let store = Arc::clone(&store);
18352            let barrier = Arc::clone(&barrier);
18353            let meta = meta.clone();
18354            std::thread::spawn(move || {
18355                barrier.wait();
18356                let key_tag = b"key_alpha:";
18357                let data = NodeData::new(bytes::Bytes::from_static(b"key_alpha:payload_alpha"));
18358                store.create_or_upsert_established_validated(
18359                    &col_id,
18360                    &meta,
18361                    &node_id,
18362                    &data,
18363                    &mut |existing| {
18364                        if let Some(existing) = existing {
18365                            if !existing.bytes.starts_with(key_tag) {
18366                                return Err(StorageError::Collision("key mismatch".into()));
18367                            }
18368                        }
18369                        Ok(())
18370                    },
18371                )
18372            })
18373        };
18374
18375        let t2 = {
18376            let store = Arc::clone(&store);
18377            let barrier = Arc::clone(&barrier);
18378            let meta = meta.clone();
18379            std::thread::spawn(move || {
18380                barrier.wait();
18381                let key_tag = b"key_beta:";
18382                let data = NodeData::new(bytes::Bytes::from_static(b"key_beta:payload_beta"));
18383                store.create_or_upsert_established_validated(
18384                    &col_id,
18385                    &meta,
18386                    &node_id,
18387                    &data,
18388                    &mut |existing| {
18389                        if let Some(existing) = existing {
18390                            if !existing.bytes.starts_with(key_tag) {
18391                                return Err(StorageError::Collision("key mismatch".into()));
18392                            }
18393                        }
18394                        Ok(())
18395                    },
18396                )
18397            })
18398        };
18399
18400        let res1 = t1.join().unwrap();
18401        let res2 = t2.join().unwrap();
18402
18403        // Exactly one thread must win, and the other must get Collision
18404        let (winner, _loser) = match (res1, res2) {
18405            (Ok(()), Err(StorageError::Collision(_))) => ("alpha", "beta"),
18406            (Err(StorageError::Collision(_)), Ok(())) => ("beta", "alpha"),
18407            (r1, r2) => panic!("unexpected outcome: r1={r1:?}, r2={r2:?}"),
18408        };
18409
18410        let final_data = store.get(&col_id, &node_id).unwrap().unwrap();
18411        if winner == "alpha" {
18412            assert!(final_data.bytes.starts_with(b"key_alpha:"));
18413        } else {
18414            assert!(final_data.bytes.starts_with(b"key_beta:"));
18415        }
18416    }
18417    /// With a journal a sync only has to fsync the WAL, so pack data would pile
18418    /// up until the checkpoint. Once enough is unsynced a sync also fsyncs the
18419    /// packs, in slices; the budget can be turned off.
18420    #[test]
18421    fn a_journal_sync_fsyncs_packs_once_a_budget_of_them_is_unsynced() {
18422        for (budget, expect_fsync) in [(0_u64, false), (1024, true)] {
18423            let dir = test_dir(&format!("pack_budget_{budget}"));
18424            let wal = dir.join("budget.wal");
18425            let store = PackfileStorage::open(dir.clone()).unwrap();
18426            store.enable_journal(&wal).unwrap();
18427            let collection = [0x11u8; 16];
18428            // The first sync is the store's first checkpoint, which fsyncs every
18429            // pack whatever the budget; take it before measuring the delta path.
18430            store
18431                .put(
18432                    &collection,
18433                    &[0xFE; 16],
18434                    &NodeData::new(bytes::Bytes::from_static(b"base")),
18435                )
18436                .unwrap();
18437            store.sync().unwrap();
18438            store.set_pack_fsync_budget(budget);
18439            for index in 0..64u8 {
18440                store
18441                    .put(
18442                        &collection,
18443                        &[index; 16],
18444                        &NodeData::new(bytes::Bytes::from(vec![index; 200])),
18445                    )
18446                    .unwrap();
18447            }
18448            store.sync().unwrap();
18449            let timings = store.sync_timings().unwrap();
18450            assert_eq!(
18451                store.shards.unsynced_bytes() == 0,
18452                expect_fsync,
18453                "budget {budget}: packs synced or not"
18454            );
18455            assert_eq!(
18456                !timings.pack_fsync.is_zero(),
18457                expect_fsync,
18458                "budget {budget}"
18459            );
18460            drop(store);
18461            let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(&dir);
18462        }
18463    }

18465    /// A checkpoint records journal coverage, so it must leave every pack byte
18466    /// durable, whatever the incremental budget did before it.
18467    #[test]
18468    fn a_checkpoint_leaves_no_pack_bytes_unsynced_whatever_the_budget() {
18469        for budget in [0_u64, 1 << 30] {
18470            let dir = test_dir(&format!("checkpoint_syncs_packs_{budget}"));
18471            let wal = dir.join("checkpoint.wal");
18472            let store = PackfileStorage::open(dir.clone()).unwrap();
18473            store.enable_journal(&wal).unwrap();
18474            store.set_pack_fsync_budget(budget);
18475            let collection = [0x12u8; 16];
18476            for index in 0..32u8 {
18477                store
18478                    .put(
18479                        &collection,
18480                        &[index; 16],
18481                        &NodeData::new(bytes::Bytes::from(vec![index; 300])),
18482                    )
18483                    .unwrap();
18484            }
18485            store.force_index_checkpoint().unwrap();
18486            assert_eq!(store.shards.unsynced_bytes(), 0, "budget {budget}");
18487            drop(store);
18488            let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(&dir);
18489        }
18490    }
18491    /// After the writer reclaims its journal on the strength of a delta coverage
18492    /// batch (no new checkpoint), a reader that attaches sees every record that
18493    /// is now only covered there: the reader loads the checkpoint, applies the
18494    /// delta operations the coverage claim describes, and binds its coverage to
18495    /// the claim, so nothing falls into the gap the reclaim left.
18496    #[cfg(feature = "multi-reader")]
18497    #[test]
18498    fn a_reader_sees_records_covered_only_by_a_delta_coverage_batch() {
18499        let dir = test_dir("reader_delta_coverage");
18500        let wal = dir.join("wal.bin");
18501        let collection = [0x4Au8; 16];
18502        let key = |index: u8| [index; 16];
18503
18504        let writer = PackfileStorage::open(dir.clone()).unwrap();
18505        writer.enable_journal(&wal).unwrap();
18506        // Force the coverage step on every sync.
18507        writer.journal().unwrap().set_reclaim_trigger_len(1);
18508        writer
18509            .put(
18510                &collection,
18511                &key(1),
18512                &NodeData::new(bytes::Bytes::from_static(b"one")),
18513            )
18514            .unwrap();
18515        writer.sync().unwrap();
18516        let checkpoint = crate::index::checkpoint::read_checkpoint(
18517            &PackfileStorage::index_checkpoint_path(&dir),
18518        )
18519        .unwrap();
18520
18521        for index in 2..=6u8 {
18522            writer
18523                .put(
18524                    &collection,
18525                    &key(index),
18526                    &NodeData::new(bytes::Bytes::from(vec![index; 8])),
18527                )
18528                .unwrap();
18529            writer.sync().unwrap();
18530            let timings = writer.sync_timings().unwrap();
18531            assert!(
18532                timings.checkpoint.is_zero(),
18533                "sync {index} rewrote the checkpoint"
18534            );
18535            assert!(
18536                !timings.delta_log.is_zero(),
18537                "sync {index} wrote no coverage batch"
18538            );
18539        }
18540        assert!(
18541            writer.durable_coverage() > checkpoint.covered_lsn,
18542            "coverage must have advanced past the checkpoint's"
18543        );
18544        let base_lsn = Journal::scan_read_only(&wal).unwrap().base_lsn;
18545        assert!(
18546            base_lsn > checkpoint.covered_lsn.saturating_add(1),
18547            "the journal was reclaimed past the checkpoint's coverage"
18548        );
18549
18550        let reader = PackfileStorage::open_read_only(dir.clone()).unwrap();
18551        reader.enable_read_journal(&wal).unwrap();
18552        let ids: Vec<NodeId> = (1..=6u8).map(key).collect();
18553        let values = reader.get_read_committed(&collection, &ids).unwrap();
18554        for (index, value) in values.iter().enumerate() {
18555            assert!(
18556                value.is_some(),
18557                "record {} is invisible to the reader",
18558                index + 1
18559            );
18560        }
18561        drop(writer);
18562        let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(&dir);
18563    }
18564    /// A reader that attached before the writer advanced coverage by delta
18565    /// batch must reload correctly when the reclaim moves the journal past its
18566    /// index: the reload applies the delta operations up to the last coverage
18567    /// claim, records after it still come from the overlay, and a record the
18568    /// writer overwrote in a covered batch is served at its newest value.
18569    #[cfg(feature = "multi-reader")]
18570    #[test]
18571    fn a_reader_attached_earlier_reloads_through_the_delta_coverage_prefix() {
18572        let dir = test_dir("reader_delta_coverage_reload");
18573        let wal = dir.join("wal.bin");
18574        let collection = [0x4Cu8; 16];
18575        let key = |index: u8| [index; 16];
18576        let value = |bytes: &'static [u8]| NodeData::new(bytes::Bytes::from_static(bytes));
18577
18578        let writer = PackfileStorage::open(dir.clone()).unwrap();
18579        writer.enable_journal(&wal).unwrap();
18580        writer.journal().unwrap().set_reclaim_trigger_len(1);
18581        writer.put(&collection, &key(1), &value(b"one")).unwrap();
18582        writer.sync().unwrap();
18583
18584        // The reader attaches now: its index is the first checkpoint.
18585        let reader = PackfileStorage::open_read_only(dir.clone()).unwrap();
18586        reader.enable_read_journal(&wal).unwrap();
18587        assert_eq!(reader.read_covered_lsn.load(Ordering::Acquire), 1);
18588
18589        // Coverage moves ahead by delta batches, overwriting key 1 on the way.
18590        writer.put(&collection, &key(2), &value(b"two")).unwrap();
18591        writer.put(&collection, &key(1), &value(b"one-v2")).unwrap();
18592        writer.sync().unwrap();
18593        writer.put(&collection, &key(3), &value(b"three")).unwrap();
18594        writer.sync().unwrap();
18595        assert!(writer.sync_timings().unwrap().checkpoint.is_zero());
18596        // A record after the last coverage batch, journalled and synced only in
18597        // the WAL: no coverage step is possible without new uncovered frames, so
18598        // stop the writer from taking one for it.
18599        writer.journal().unwrap().set_reclaim_trigger_len(u64::MAX);
18600        writer.put(&collection, &key(4), &value(b"four")).unwrap();
18601        writer.sync().unwrap();
18602        assert!(writer.sync_timings().unwrap().delta_log.as_nanos() > 0);
18603
18604        let ids: Vec<NodeId> = (1..=4u8).map(key).collect();
18605        let values = reader.get_read_committed(&collection, &ids).unwrap();
18606        let payloads: Vec<Option<&[u8]>> = values
18607            .iter()
18608            .map(|value| value.as_ref().map(|data| data.bytes.as_ref()))
18609            .collect();
18610        assert_eq!(
18611            payloads,
18612            vec![
18613                Some(&b"one-v2"[..]),
18614                Some(&b"two"[..]),
18615                Some(&b"three"[..]),
18616                Some(&b"four"[..]),
18617            ]
18618        );
18619        assert!(
18620            reader.stats().read_reloads >= 1,
18621            "the reclaim must have forced a reload"
18622        );
18623        assert!(
18624            reader.read_covered_lsn.load(Ordering::Acquire) > 1,
18625            "the reload must have bound coverage to the delta claim"
18626        );
18627        drop(writer);
18628        let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(&dir);
18629    }
18630    /// A reader attached before a burst that grows the collection's table
18631    /// several times reloads through the delta coverage prefix: it replays the
18632    /// redo records with the same rules as an open, growing its own copy of the
18633    /// table, and finds every record. The burst reaches the log as redo records
18634    /// only, no snapshot.
18635    #[cfg(feature = "multi-reader")]
18636    #[test]
18637    fn a_reader_reloads_through_a_burst_that_grows_the_table() {
18638        let dir = test_dir("reader_reload_growth");
18639        let wal = dir.join("wal.bin");
18640        let collection = [0x4D; 16];
18641        let writer = PackfileStorage::open(dir.clone()).unwrap();
18642        writer.enable_journal(&wal).unwrap();
18643        writer.journal().unwrap().set_reclaim_trigger_len(1);
18644        writer
18645            .put(
18646                &collection,
18647                &batch_node(u32::MAX),
18648                &NodeData::from_slice(b"seed"),
18649            )
18650            .unwrap();
18651        writer.sync().unwrap();
18652        let capacity_before = writer.generation(&collection).unwrap().index.capacity();
18653
18654        // The reader attaches now: its index is the small first checkpoint.
18655        let reader = PackfileStorage::open_read_only(dir.clone()).unwrap();
18656        reader.enable_read_journal(&wal).unwrap();
18657
18658        let entries: Vec<(NodeId, NodeData)> = (0..700u32)
18659            .map(|i| (batch_node(i), NodeData::from_slice(&i.to_le_bytes())))
18660            .collect();
18661        writer.put_many(&collection, &entries).unwrap();
18662        writer.sync().unwrap();
18663        assert!(
18664            writer.generation(&collection).unwrap().index.capacity() > capacity_before * 4,
18665            "the burst must grow the table more than once"
18666        );
18667        assert!(
18668            writer.sync_timings().unwrap().checkpoint.is_zero(),
18669            "the burst is a delta step, not a checkpoint"
18670        );
18671        assert_log_has_redo_and_no_snapshot(&writer, entries.len());
18672
18673        // One more record that stays only in the WAL (no coverage step for it):
18674        // the reader then sees a journal that starts past its index and must
18675        // reload through the delta prefix, so the burst's records are served
18676        // from a replayed (grown) table, not by refreshing on a miss.
18677        writer.journal().unwrap().set_reclaim_trigger_len(u64::MAX);
18678        writer
18679            .put(
18680                &collection,
18681                &batch_node(9_999),
18682                &NodeData::from_slice(b"tail"),
18683            )
18684            .unwrap();
18685        writer.sync().unwrap();
18686        let seed = reader
18687            .get_read_committed(&collection, &[batch_node(u32::MAX)])
18688            .unwrap();
18689        assert_eq!(seed[0].as_ref().unwrap().bytes.as_ref(), b"seed");
18690        let ids: Vec<NodeId> = entries.iter().map(|(id, _)| *id).collect();
18691        let found = reader.get_read_committed(&collection, &ids).unwrap();
18692        for (index, ((_, expected), value)) in entries.iter().zip(found.iter()).enumerate() {
18693            let data = value
18694                .as_ref()
18695                .unwrap_or_else(|| panic!("record {index} of the burst is missing for the reader"));
18696            assert_eq!(data.bytes, expected.bytes);
18697        }
18698        let tail = reader
18699            .get_read_committed(&collection, &[batch_node(9_999)])
18700            .unwrap();
18701        assert_eq!(tail[0].as_ref().unwrap().bytes.as_ref(), b"tail");
18702        assert!(
18703            reader.stats().read_reloads >= 1,
18704            "the reclaim must have forced a reload"
18705        );
18706        assert_eq!(reader.stats().read_reload_failures, 0);
18707        assert_eq!(
18708            reader.stats().miss_refreshes,
18709            0,
18710            "every record came from the replayed table, none by refreshing on a miss"
18711        );
18712        drop(writer);
18713        let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(&dir);
18714    }
18715
18716    /// A writer with a journal that syncs under the size trigger: every sync
18717    /// past the first is a delta coverage step. Returns the store and the keys.
18718    #[cfg(feature = "multi-reader")]
18719    fn writer_with_coverage_steps(
18720        dir: &std::path::Path,
18721        wal: &std::path::Path,
18722        records: u8,
18723    ) -> PackfileStorage {
18724        let writer = PackfileStorage::open(dir.to_path_buf()).unwrap();
18725        writer.enable_journal(wal).unwrap();
18726        writer.journal().unwrap().set_reclaim_trigger_len(1);
18727        for index in 1..=records {
18728            writer
18729                .put(
18730                    &[0x4Du8; 16],
18731                    &[index; 16],
18732                    &NodeData::new(bytes::Bytes::from(vec![index; 16])),
18733                )
18734                .unwrap();
18735            writer.sync().unwrap();
18736        }
18737        writer
18738    }
18739
18740    /// Reopen a store with a journal and check every record is served.
18741    #[cfg(feature = "multi-reader")]
18742    fn reopen_and_read_all(
18743        dir: &std::path::Path,
18744        wal: &std::path::Path,
18745        records: u8,
18746    ) -> PackfileStorage {
18747        let reopened = PackfileStorage::open(dir.to_path_buf()).unwrap();
18748        reopened.enable_journal(wal).unwrap();
18749        reopened.replay_journal().unwrap();
18750        for index in 1..=records {
18751            let value = reopened.get(&[0x4Du8; 16], &[index; 16]).unwrap();
18752            assert_eq!(
18753                value.map(|data| data.bytes.to_vec()),
18754                Some(vec![index; 16]),
18755                "record {index} lost across the reopen"
18756            );
18757        }
18758        reopened
18759    }
18760
18761    /// Crash after coverage steps and a reclaim that went past the checkpoint:
18762    /// the reopened writer takes its coverage from the delta claim, replays only
18763    /// what is uncovered, and loses nothing.
18764    #[cfg(feature = "multi-reader")]
18765    #[test]
18766    fn a_writer_recovers_from_a_reclaim_licensed_by_a_delta_coverage_batch() {
18767        let dir = test_dir("recover_delta_coverage");
18768        let wal = dir.join("wal.bin");
18769        let writer = writer_with_coverage_steps(&dir, &wal, 6);
18770        let checkpoint_coverage = crate::index::checkpoint::read_checkpoint(
18771            &PackfileStorage::index_checkpoint_path(&dir),
18772        )
18773        .unwrap()
18774        .covered_lsn;
18775        let claimed = writer.durable_coverage();
18776        assert!(
18777            claimed > checkpoint_coverage,
18778            "the delta path must have advanced coverage"
18779        );
18780        assert!(
18781            Journal::scan_read_only(&wal).unwrap().base_lsn > checkpoint_coverage.saturating_add(1),
18782            "the journal must have been reclaimed past the checkpoint"
18783        );
18784        drop(writer); // no clean shutdown work is relied on: everything below is on disk
18785
18786        assert_eq!(
18787            PackfileStorage::read_journal_lsn(&dir),
18788            claimed,
18789            "the disk must say what the writer claimed"
18790        );
18791        let reopened = reopen_and_read_all(&dir, &wal, 6);
18792        assert_eq!(reopened.durable_coverage(), claimed);
18793        drop(reopened);
18794        let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(&dir);
18795    }
18796
18797    /// A coverage batch that is torn, or whose bytes are damaged, claims
18798    /// nothing. The journal was reclaimed on the strength of it and cannot help,
18799    /// but the packs it described are durable, so the reopen rebuilds the index
18800    /// from them and every record is still there.
18801    #[cfg(feature = "multi-reader")]
18802    #[test]
18803    fn a_torn_or_damaged_coverage_batch_loses_no_records() {
18804        let dir = test_dir("torn_delta_coverage");
18805        let wal = dir.join("wal.bin");
18806        let writer = writer_with_coverage_steps(&dir, &wal, 6);
18807        let checkpoint = crate::index::checkpoint::read_checkpoint(
18808            &PackfileStorage::index_checkpoint_path(&dir),
18809        )
18810        .unwrap();
18811        drop(writer);
18812        let delta_path = PackfileStorage::delta_path(&dir, checkpoint.fingerprint);
18813        let intact = fs::read(&delta_path).unwrap();
18814        assert!(
18815            delta::read_delta_log_v3(&delta_path)
18816                .unwrap()
18817                .coverage
18818                .is_some(),
18819            "the log must carry a coverage claim to lose"
18820        );
18821
18822        // Cut the log inside its last batch, and separately flip a bit in it.
18823        let cut = intact.len() - 3;
18824        let mut damaged = intact.clone();
18825        let last = damaged.len() - 20;
18826        damaged[last] ^= 0x40;
18827        for (label, bytes) in [("torn", intact[..cut].to_vec()), ("bit flip", damaged)] {
18828            fs::write(&delta_path, &bytes).unwrap();
18829            let claimed = PackfileStorage::read_journal_lsn(&dir);
18830            let last_claim = delta::read_delta_log_v3(&delta_path)
18831                .and_then(|log| log.coverage)
18832                .unwrap_or(0);
18833            assert!(
18834                claimed == checkpoint.covered_lsn.max(last_claim),
18835                "{label}: coverage must come only from what still validates"
18836            );
18837            let reopened = reopen_and_read_all(&dir, &wal, 6);
18838            drop(reopened);
18839            // A reopen must not have kept the damaged log going.
18840            fs::write(&delta_path, &intact).unwrap();
18841        }
18842        let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(&dir);
18843    }
18844
18845    /// Without a coverage step (the journal is not over its trigger) nothing is
18846    /// claimed beyond the checkpoint, the journal keeps its groups, and a crash
18847    /// replays them: the behaviour before coverage batches existed.
18848    #[cfg(feature = "multi-reader")]
18849    #[test]
18850    fn a_sync_under_the_trigger_claims_no_coverage() {
18851        let dir = test_dir("no_coverage_under_trigger");
18852        let wal = dir.join("wal.bin");
18853        let writer = PackfileStorage::open(dir.clone()).unwrap();
18854        writer.enable_journal(&wal).unwrap();
18855        writer
18856            .put(
18857                &[0x4Du8; 16],
18858                &[1; 16],
18859                &NodeData::new(bytes::Bytes::from(vec![1; 16])),
18860            )
18861            .unwrap();
18862        writer.sync().unwrap();
18863        let after_checkpoint = writer.durable_coverage();
18864        for index in 2..=4u8 {
18865            writer
18866                .put(
18867                    &[0x4Du8; 16],
18868                    &[index; 16],
18869                    &NodeData::new(bytes::Bytes::from(vec![index; 16])),
18870                )
18871                .unwrap();
18872            writer.sync().unwrap();
18873            let timings = writer.sync_timings().unwrap();
18874            assert!(timings.checkpoint.is_zero());
18875            assert!(!timings.delta_log.is_zero(), "an ordinary delta batch");
18876        }
18877        assert_eq!(writer.durable_coverage(), after_checkpoint);
18878        let groups = Journal::scan_read_only(&wal).unwrap().groups.len();
18879        assert!(
18880            groups >= 3,
18881            "the journal keeps the uncovered groups ({groups})"
18882        );
18883        drop(writer);
18884        drop(reopen_and_read_all(&dir, &wal, 4));
18885        let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(&dir);
18886    }
