18888    /// The one-pass durable state gives what the two separate readers gave: the
18889    /// coverage `read_journal_lsn` reports and the fingerprint
18890    /// `read_durable_fingerprint` reports, with and without a coverage claim in
18891    /// the delta log.
18892    #[cfg(feature = "multi-reader")]
18893    #[test]
18894    fn the_one_pass_durable_state_matches_the_separate_readers() {
18895        let dir = test_dir("one_pass_durable_state");
18896        let wal = dir.join("wal.bin");
18897        let writer = writer_with_coverage_steps(&dir, &wal, 5);
18898        drop(writer);
18899        let state = PackfileStorage::durable_index_state(&dir);
18900        let fingerprint = crate::index::checkpoint::read_durable_fingerprint(&dir)
18901            .unwrap()
18902            .expect("a durable fingerprint")
18903            .fingerprint;
18904        assert_eq!(state.fingerprint, fingerprint);
18905        assert!(state.covered_lsn > 0, "the log must carry a claim");
18906        assert_eq!(
18907            PackfileStorage::read_journal_lsn(&dir),
18908            state
18909                .covered_lsn
18910                .max(PackfileStorage::journal_lsn_with(&dir, 0)),
18911        );
18912        // No log for the checkpoint: the fingerprint is the checkpoint's own.
18913        let checkpoint = crate::index::checkpoint::read_checkpoint(
18914            &PackfileStorage::index_checkpoint_path(&dir),
18915        )
18916        .unwrap();
18917        fs::remove_file(PackfileStorage::delta_path(&dir, checkpoint.fingerprint)).unwrap();
18918        let bare = PackfileStorage::durable_index_state(&dir);
18919        assert_eq!(bare.fingerprint, checkpoint.fingerprint);
18920        assert_eq!(bare.covered_lsn, checkpoint.covered_lsn);
18921        let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(&dir);
18922    }
18923
18924    /// The one-pass state also matches the separate readers when the log names
18925    /// another checkpoint, and when its tail is torn.
18926    #[cfg(feature = "multi-reader")]
18927    #[test]
18928    fn the_one_pass_durable_state_matches_for_a_foreign_or_torn_log() {
18929        let dir = test_dir("one_pass_foreign_torn");
18930        let wal = dir.join("wal.bin");
18931        let writer = writer_with_coverage_steps(&dir, &wal, 5);
18932        drop(writer);
18933        let checkpoint = crate::index::checkpoint::read_checkpoint(
18934            &PackfileStorage::index_checkpoint_path(&dir),
18935        )
18936        .unwrap();
18937        let log_path = PackfileStorage::delta_path(&dir, checkpoint.fingerprint);
18938        let intact = fs::read(&log_path).unwrap();
18939
18940        // Torn: cut inside the last batch. The fingerprint is whatever the last
18941        // intact batch ended at, exactly as `read_durable_fingerprint` says.
18942        fs::write(&log_path, &intact[..intact.len() - 3]).unwrap();
18943        let torn = PackfileStorage::durable_index_state(&dir);
18944        let reference = crate::index::checkpoint::read_durable_fingerprint(&dir)
18945            .unwrap()
18946            .expect("a fingerprint");
18947        assert!(reference.torn_tail);
18948        assert_eq!(torn.fingerprint, reference.fingerprint);
18949        let tail = delta::read_delta_tail_fingerprint(&log_path)
18950            .unwrap()
18951            .unwrap();
18952        assert_eq!(
18953            torn.covered_lsn,
18954            checkpoint.covered_lsn.max(tail.coverage.unwrap_or(0))
18955        );
18956
18957        // Foreign: a log that continues a different checkpoint is inert.
18958        fs::remove_file(&log_path).unwrap();
18959        delta::append_v3_batch_with_durability(
18960            &log_path,
18961            true,
18962            checkpoint.fingerprint ^ 1,
18963            &[delta::DeltaOperation::Coverage {
18964                covered_lsn: u64::MAX,
18965            }],
18966            0x99,
18967            false,
18968        )
18969        .unwrap();
18970        let foreign = PackfileStorage::durable_index_state(&dir);
18971        assert_eq!(foreign.fingerprint, checkpoint.fingerprint);
18972        assert_eq!(foreign.covered_lsn, checkpoint.covered_lsn);
18973        let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(&dir);
18974    }

18976    /// The redo ordering key survives a checkpoint and a reopen: the counter
18977    /// resumes at the base sequence the checkpoint recorded.
18978    #[test]
18979    fn the_delta_sequence_resumes_from_the_checkpoints_base_after_a_reopen() {
18980        let dir = test_dir("delta_seq_reopen");
18981        let store = PackfileStorage::open(dir.clone()).unwrap();
18982        store
18983            .put(&[0xD7; 16], &batch_node(1), &NodeData::from_slice(b"one"))
18984            .unwrap();
18985        store.delta_state.lock().delta_seq_high = 17;
18986        store.sync_all().unwrap();
18987        drop(store);
18988        let reopened = PackfileStorage::open(dir.clone()).unwrap();
18989        assert_eq!(reopened.delta_state.lock().delta_seq_high, 17);
18990        drop(reopened);
18991        fs::remove_dir_all(dir).unwrap();
18992    }
18993
18994    /// Puts after a checkpoint are recorded as logical redo records with
18995    /// increasing sequence numbers, and a reopen replays them in order: an
18996    /// overwrite of an identity converges to its last locator, and the counter
18997    /// resumes above the last sequence in the log.
18998    #[test]
18999    fn logical_redo_replays_in_order_and_the_counter_resumes_above_the_log() {
19000        let dir = test_dir("logical_redo_order");
19001        let store = PackfileStorage::open(dir.clone()).unwrap();
19002        let collection = [0xD8; 16];
19003        store
19004            .put(&collection, &batch_node(1), &NodeData::from_slice(b"first"))
19005            .unwrap();
19006        store.sync_all().unwrap();
19007        store
19008            .put(
19009                &collection,
19010                &batch_node(1),
19011                &NodeData::from_slice(b"second"),
19012            )
19013            .unwrap();
19014        store
19015            .put(&collection, &batch_node(2), &NodeData::from_slice(b"other"))
19016            .unwrap();
19017        let seqs: Vec<u64> = match &store.delta_state.lock().pending[&collection] {
19018            PendingDelta::Redo(records) => records.iter().map(|record| record.delta_seq).collect(),
19019            _ => panic!("puts after a checkpoint are recorded as redo records"),
19020        };
19021        assert_eq!(seqs.len(), 2);
19022        assert!(seqs[0] < seqs[1], "sequence order is append order");
19023        store.sync_all().unwrap();
19024        drop(store);
19025
19026        let reopened = PackfileStorage::open(dir.clone()).unwrap();
19027        assert_eq!(reopened.open_timings().unwrap().path, OpenPath::Checkpoint);
19028        assert_eq!(
19029            reopened
19030                .get(&collection, &batch_node(1))
19031                .unwrap()
19032                .unwrap()
19033                .bytes,
19034            bytes::Bytes::from_static(b"second"),
19035            "the overwrite converges to its last locator"
19036        );
19037        assert!(reopened.get(&collection, &batch_node(2)).unwrap().is_some());
19038        assert!(reopened.delta_state.lock().delta_seq_high >= seqs[1]);
19039        drop(reopened);
19040        fs::remove_dir_all(dir).unwrap();
19041    }
19042
19043    /// A redo log that names an unknown pack, a locator outside its pack, or a
19044    /// sequence that does not increase is rejected, and the open falls back to a
19045    /// rescan that still finds every record. The unmodified log is trusted.
19046    #[test]
19047    fn a_bad_redo_log_is_rejected_and_the_open_rescans() {
19048        fn open_after(mutate: impl Fn(&mut RedoRecord)) -> (OpenPath, usize) {
19049            let dir = test_dir("bad_redo_log");
19050            let collection = [0xD9; 16];
19051            let store = PackfileStorage::open(dir.clone()).unwrap();
19052            store
19053                .put(&collection, &batch_node(0), &NodeData::from_slice(b"base"))
19054                .unwrap();
19055            store.sync_all().unwrap();
19056            for id in 1..=5 {
19057                store
19058                    .put(&collection, &batch_node(id), &NodeData::from_slice(b"redo"))
19059                    .unwrap();
19060            }
19061            store.sync_all().unwrap();
19062            let base = store.delta_state.lock().base_fingerprint.unwrap();
19063            drop(store);
19064
19065            let path = PackfileStorage::delta_path(&dir, base);
19066            let log = delta::read_delta_log_v3(&path).unwrap();
19067            let mut operations = log.operations;
19068            let mut mutated = 0;
19069            for operation in &mut operations {
19070                if let DeltaOperation::Redo(record) = operation {
19071                    mutate(record);
19072                    mutated += 1;
19073                }
19074            }
19075            assert!(mutated > 0, "the log must hold redo records");
19076            fs::remove_file(&path).unwrap();
19077            delta::append_v3_batch_with_durability(
19078                &path,
19079                true,
19080                log.base_fingerprint,
19081                &operations,
19082                log.tail_fingerprint,
19083                false,
19084            )
19085            .unwrap();
19086
19087            let reopened = PackfileStorage::open(dir.clone()).unwrap();
19088            let path_taken = reopened.open_timings().unwrap().path;
19089            let found = (0..=5)
19090                .filter(|id| {
19091                    reopened
19092                        .get(&collection, &batch_node(*id))
19093                        .unwrap()
19094                        .is_some()
19095                })
19096                .count();
19097            drop(reopened);
19098            fs::remove_dir_all(dir).unwrap();
19099            (path_taken, found)
19100        }
19101
19102        assert_eq!(open_after(|_| {}), (OpenPath::Checkpoint, 6), "control");
19103        let unknown_pack = |record: &mut RedoRecord| {
19104            if let RedoOp::Set { pack_id, .. } = &mut record.op {
19105                *pack_id += 1000;
19106            }
19107        };
19108        let out_of_extent = |record: &mut RedoRecord| {
19109            if let RedoOp::Set { offset, .. } = &mut record.op {
19110                *offset = crate::index::IndexEntry::MAX_OFFSET;
19111            }
19112        };
19113        let flat_sequence = |record: &mut RedoRecord| record.delta_seq = 0;
19114        assert_eq!(open_after(unknown_pack), (OpenPath::FullScan, 6));
19115        assert_eq!(open_after(out_of_extent), (OpenPath::FullScan, 6));
19116        assert_eq!(open_after(flat_sequence), (OpenPath::FullScan, 6));
19117    }
19118
19119    /// Differential: a collection driven through many batches, overwrites and
19120    /// several capacity growths after its checkpoint, synced only as deltas, must
19121    /// reopen to exactly what the live session held: every identity at its last
19122    /// value and the same number of entries. Growth is logical, so the log holds
19123    /// redo records only. Repeated across two reopens so a log continues a log.
19124    #[test]
19125    fn logical_replay_across_growth_matches_the_live_index() {
19126        let dir = test_dir("logical_replay_differential");
19127        let collection = [0xDA; 16];
19128        let mut expected: HashMap<NodeId, Vec<u8>> = HashMap::new();
19129        let mut next = 0u32;
19130        let mut round_value = 0u8;
19131        let mut drive = |store: &PackfileStorage, expected: &mut HashMap<NodeId, Vec<u8>>| {
19132            round_value = round_value.wrapping_add(1);
19133            let mut batch = Vec::new();
19134            // New identities (enough over the rounds to cross several growths).
19135            for _ in 0..400 {
19136                batch.push((batch_node(next), vec![round_value; 8]));
19137                next += 1;
19138            }
19139            // Overwrites of earlier identities with a new value.
19140            for old in (0..next.saturating_sub(400)).step_by(37) {
19141                batch.push((batch_node(old), vec![round_value; 8]));
19142            }
19143            let entries: Vec<(NodeId, NodeData)> = batch
19144                .iter()
19145                .map(|(id, value)| (*id, NodeData::from_slice(value)))
19146                .collect();
19147            store.put_many(&collection, &entries).unwrap();
19148            for (id, value) in batch {
19149                expected.insert(id, value);
19150            }
19151            // A few single puts too (the other recording path).
19152            for _ in 0..5 {
19153                store
19154                    .put(
19155                        &collection,
19156                        &batch_node(next),
19157                        &NodeData::from_slice(&[round_value; 8]),
19158                    )
19159                    .unwrap();
19160                expected.insert(batch_node(next), vec![round_value; 8]);
19161                next += 1;
19162            }
19163            store.sync_all().unwrap();
19164        };
19165        let verify = |store: &PackfileStorage, expected: &HashMap<NodeId, Vec<u8>>| {
19166            for (id, value) in expected {
19167                assert_eq!(
19168                    store.get(&collection, id).unwrap().unwrap().bytes.as_ref(),
19169                    value.as_slice(),
19170                    "a record diverged from the live session"
19171                );
19172            }
19173            assert_eq!(
19174                store.generation(&collection).unwrap().index.len(),
19175                expected.len(),
19176                "the index holds a different number of entries"
19177            );
19178        };
19179
19180        let store = PackfileStorage::open(dir.clone()).unwrap();
19181        store
19182            .put(
19183                &collection,
19184                &batch_node(u32::MAX),
19185                &NodeData::from_slice(b"seed"),
19186            )
19187            .unwrap();
19188        expected.insert(batch_node(u32::MAX), b"seed".to_vec());
19189        store.sync_all().unwrap(); // the checkpoint every later batch continues
19190        let grows_before = store.stats().index_grow_count;
19191        for _ in 0..8 {
19192            drive(&store, &mut expected);
19193        }
19194        assert!(
19195            store.stats().index_grow_count > grows_before,
19196            "the workload must cross capacity growths after the checkpoint"
19197        );
19198        drop(store);
19199
19200        // Reopen 1: replays a log of redo records, then keeps appending to it.
19201        let reopened = PackfileStorage::open(dir.clone()).unwrap();
19202        assert_eq!(reopened.open_timings().unwrap().path, OpenPath::Checkpoint);
19203        verify(&reopened, &expected);
19204        assert_log_has_redo_and_no_snapshot(&reopened, 1);
19205        for _ in 0..4 {
19206            drive(&reopened, &mut expected);
19207        }
19208        drop(reopened);
19209
19210        // Reopen 2: a log that continued a replayed log.
19211        let again = PackfileStorage::open(dir.clone()).unwrap();
19212        assert_eq!(again.open_timings().unwrap().path, OpenPath::Checkpoint);
19213        verify(&again, &expected);
19214        drop(again);
19215        fs::remove_dir_all(dir).unwrap();
19216    }
19217
19218    /// Applying redo sets is idempotent and order-convergent: replaying the whole
19219    /// sequence twice, or over an image that already holds a prefix of it, gives
19220    /// the same identities and locators as applying it once, with the last write
19221    /// of an identity winning.
19222    #[test]
19223    fn applying_redo_sets_is_idempotent_and_order_convergent() {
19224        let config = crate::index::IndexConfig {
19225            seed: 0x1D3A,
19226            ..crate::index::IndexConfig::default()
19227        };
19228        let pack_lookup: HashMap<u64, (u16, u64)> = HashMap::from([(7, (2, 1 << 20))]);
19229        let hash = |seq: u32| {
19230            let mut hash = [0u8; 16];
19231            hash[..4].copy_from_slice(&seq.to_le_bytes());
19232            hash[4..8].copy_from_slice(&seq.wrapping_mul(0x9E37_79B1).to_le_bytes());
19233            hash[8..12].copy_from_slice(&seq.wrapping_mul(0x85EB_CA6B).to_le_bytes());
19234            hash[12..].copy_from_slice(&seq.wrapping_mul(0xC2B2_AE35).to_le_bytes());
19235            hash
19236        };
19237        // 300 distinct identities, then overwrites of every third to new locators.
19238        let mut records = Vec::new();
19239        let mut seq = 0u64;
19240        for id in 0..300u32 {
19241            seq += 1;
19242            records.push(RedoRecord {
19243                collection_id: [1; 16],
19244                op: RedoOp::Set {
19245                    full_hash: hash(id),
19246                    pack_id: 7,
19247                    offset: 1_000 + u64::from(id) * 64,
19248                    record_len: 61,
19249                },
19250                delta_seq: seq,
19251                base_generation: 1,
19252            });
19253        }
19254        for id in (0..300u32).step_by(3) {
19255            seq += 1;
19256            records.push(RedoRecord {
19257                collection_id: [1; 16],
19258                op: RedoOp::Set {
19259                    full_hash: hash(id),
19260                    pack_id: 7,
19261                    offset: 500_000 + u64::from(id) * 64,
19262                    record_len: 61,
19263                },
19264                delta_seq: seq,
19265                base_generation: 1,
19266            });
19267        }
19268        let fresh = || LossyIndex::with_config(16, config);
19269        let once = PackfileStorage::apply_redo_sets(fresh(), &records, &pack_lookup).unwrap();
19270        let twice = PackfileStorage::apply_redo_sets(once.clone(), &records, &pack_lookup).unwrap();
19271        let over_prefix = {
19272            let prefix =
19273                PackfileStorage::apply_redo_sets(fresh(), &records[..350], &pack_lookup).unwrap();
19274            PackfileStorage::apply_redo_sets(prefix, &records, &pack_lookup).unwrap()
19275        };
19276        assert_eq!(once.len(), 300, "300 distinct identities");
19277        for candidate in [&twice, &over_prefix] {
19278            assert_eq!(candidate.len(), once.len());
19279            assert_eq!(candidate.slot_counts(), once.slot_counts());
19280        }
19281        for id in 0..300u32 {
19282            let expected_offset = if id % 3 == 0 {
19283                500_000 + u64::from(id) * 64
19284            } else {
19285                1_000 + u64::from(id) * 64
19286            };
19287            for index in [&once, &twice, &over_prefix] {
19288                assert_eq!(
19289                    index.lookup(&hash(id)),
19290                    Some((2, expected_offset)),
19291                    "identity {id}: the last write wins"
19292                );
19293            }
19294        }
19295    }
19296
19297    /// A replayed record whose locator is wrong but in bounds (it points at
19298    /// another valid record of the same pack) would install and then read as a
19299    /// missing key. Replay verifies each locator's frame, so the log is rejected
19300    /// and the open rescans, finding every record.
19301    #[test]
19302    fn a_wrong_but_in_bounds_locator_rejects_the_log_and_the_open_rescans() {
19303        let dir = test_dir("wrong_locator");
19304        let collection = [0xDB; 16];
19305        let store = PackfileStorage::open(dir.clone()).unwrap();
19306        store
19307            .put(&collection, &batch_node(0), &NodeData::from_slice(b"base"))
19308            .unwrap();
19309        store.sync_all().unwrap();
19310        for id in 1..=5 {
19311            store
19312                .put(&collection, &batch_node(id), &NodeData::from_slice(&[7; 8]))
19313                .unwrap();
19314        }
19315        store.sync_all().unwrap();
19316        let base = store.delta_state.lock().base_fingerprint.unwrap();
19317        drop(store);
19318        let path = PackfileStorage::delta_path(&dir, base);
19319        let log = delta::read_delta_log_v3(&path).unwrap();
19320        let mut operations = log.operations;
19321        let (donor_offset, donor_len) = operations
19322            .iter()
19323            .find_map(|operation| match operation {
19324                DeltaOperation::Redo(RedoRecord {
19325                    op:
19326                        RedoOp::Set {
19327                            offset, record_len, ..
19328                        },
19329                    ..
19330                }) => Some((*offset, *record_len)),
19331                _ => None,
19332            })
19333            .unwrap();
19334        // Point the last record (id 5) at the first record's frame.
19335        if let Some(DeltaOperation::Redo(record)) = operations
19336            .iter_mut()
19337            .filter(|operation| matches!(operation, DeltaOperation::Redo(_)))
19338            .last()
19339        {
19340            if let RedoOp::Set {
19341                offset, record_len, ..
19342            } = &mut record.op
19343            {
19344                *offset = donor_offset;
19345                *record_len = donor_len;
19346            }
19347        }
19348        fs::remove_file(&path).unwrap();
19349        delta::append_v3_batch_with_durability(
19350            &path,
19351            true,
19352            log.base_fingerprint,
19353            &operations,
19354            log.tail_fingerprint,
19355            false,
19356        )
19357        .unwrap();
19358        let reopened = PackfileStorage::open(dir.clone()).unwrap();
19359        assert_eq!(
19360            reopened.open_timings().unwrap().path,
19361            OpenPath::FullScan,
19362            "the wrong locator must be caught at open, not at the first read"
19363        );
19364        for id in 0..=5 {
19365            assert!(
19366                reopened
19367                    .get(&collection, &batch_node(id))
19368                    .unwrap()
19369                    .is_some(),
19370                "record {id} must still be found after the rescan"
19371            );
19372        }
19373        drop(reopened);
19374        fs::remove_dir_all(dir).unwrap();
19375    }

19377    /// Counts and pack identity across several packs: with small packs, growth,
19378    /// overwrites and new packs created after the checkpoint (which the redo log
19379    /// names by pack id), a reopen holds exactly the live session's records and
19380    /// per-collection entry counts, on the checkpoint path.
19381    #[test]
19382    fn logical_replay_across_several_packs_keeps_counts_and_records() {
19383        let dir = test_dir("logical_replay_packs");
19384        let collection = [0xDC; 16];
19385        let open = || PackfileStorage::open_with_max_shard_bytes(dir.clone(), 48 * 1024).unwrap();
19386        let store = open();
19387        store
19388            .put(
19389                &collection,
19390                &batch_node(u32::MAX),
19391                &NodeData::from_slice(b"seed"),
19392            )
19393            .unwrap();
19394        store.sync_all().unwrap();
19395        let mut expected: HashMap<NodeId, Vec<u8>> = HashMap::new();
19396        expected.insert(batch_node(u32::MAX), b"seed".to_vec());
19397        for round in 1..=6u8 {
19398            let entries: Vec<(NodeId, NodeData)> = (0..300u32)
19399                .map(|i| {
19400                    let id = batch_node(u32::from(round) * 1000 + i);
19401                    (id, NodeData::from_slice(&[round; 40]))
19402                })
19403                .chain((0..50u32).map(|i| (batch_node(i * 3), NodeData::from_slice(&[round; 40]))))
19404                .collect();
19405            for (id, data) in &entries {
19406                expected.insert(*id, data.bytes.to_vec());
19407            }
19408            store.put_many(&collection, &entries).unwrap();
19409            store.sync_all().unwrap();
19410        }
19411        let live_summary = store.collection_summaries();
19412        let live_packs = fs::read_dir(&dir)
19413            .unwrap()
19414            .flatten()
19415            .filter(|entry| entry.path().extension().is_some_and(|ext| ext == "pack"))
19416            .count();
19417        assert!(
19418            live_packs > 2,
19419            "the workload must span several packs ({live_packs})"
19420        );
19421        drop(store);
19422
19423        let reopened = open();
19424        assert_eq!(reopened.open_timings().unwrap().path, OpenPath::Checkpoint);
19425        assert_eq!(
19426            reopened
19427                .collection_summaries()
19428                .iter()
19429                .map(|summary| (summary.0, summary.1))
19430                .collect::<Vec<_>>(),
19431            live_summary
19432                .iter()
19433                .map(|summary| (summary.0, summary.1))
19434                .collect::<Vec<_>>(),
19435            "per-collection entry counts"
19436        );
19437        for (id, value) in &expected {
19438            assert_eq!(
19439                reopened
19440                    .get(&collection, id)
19441                    .unwrap()
19442                    .unwrap()
19443                    .bytes
19444                    .as_ref(),
19445                value.as_slice()
19446            );
19447        }
19448        drop(reopened);
19449        fs::remove_dir_all(dir).unwrap();
19450    }

19452    /// The coverage step obeys the same rotation: with the log at the rotation
19453    /// length, a sync over the trigger takes the checkpoint rather than a batch.
19454    #[cfg(feature = "multi-reader")]
19455    #[test]
19456    fn a_coverage_step_is_replaced_by_a_checkpoint_at_the_rotation_length() {
19457        let dir = test_dir("coverage_rotation");
19458        let wal = dir.join("wal.bin");
19459        let writer = writer_with_coverage_steps(&dir, &wal, 3);
19460        assert!(!writer.sync_timings().unwrap().delta_log.is_zero());
19461        let at = writer.delta_log_rotate_bytes();
19462        writer.delta_state.lock().log_bytes = at;
19463        writer
19464            .put(
19465                &[0x4Du8; 16],
19466                &[9; 16],
19467                &NodeData::new(bytes::Bytes::from(vec![9; 16])),
19468            )
19469            .unwrap();
19470        writer.sync().unwrap();
19471        let timings = writer.sync_timings().unwrap();
19472        assert!(!timings.checkpoint.is_zero(), "a full checkpoint ran");
19473        assert!(timings.delta_log.is_zero(), "no batch was appended");
19474        drop(writer);
19475        let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(&dir);
19476    }

19478    /// The coverage step is only taken while every live pack is in the base
19479    /// checkpoint's pack table, since a reader translates the delta operations'
19480    /// slots through it. A pack created since forces a full checkpoint, which
19481    /// records the new table and starts a new epoch.
19482    #[cfg(feature = "multi-reader")]
19483    #[test]
19484    fn a_pack_missing_from_the_checkpoint_table_forces_a_full_checkpoint() {
19485        let dir = test_dir("coverage_pack_gate");
19486        let wal = dir.join("wal.bin");
19487        let writer = writer_with_coverage_steps(&dir, &wal, 3);
19488        // With the table intact the step is a delta batch.
19489        writer
19490            .put(
19491                &[0x4Du8; 16],
19492                &[9; 16],
19493                &NodeData::new(bytes::Bytes::from(vec![9; 16])),
19494            )
19495            .unwrap();
19496        writer.sync().unwrap();
19497        assert!(writer.sync_timings().unwrap().checkpoint.is_zero());
19498        assert!(writer.packs_match_checkpoint_table());
19499        // Forget the table, as if a pack had been created since the checkpoint.
19500        writer.delta_state.lock().base_pack_ids.clear();
19501        assert!(!writer.packs_match_checkpoint_table());
19502        writer
19503            .put(
19504                &[0x4Du8; 16],
19505                &[10; 16],
19506                &NodeData::new(bytes::Bytes::from(vec![10; 16])),
19507            )
19508            .unwrap();
19509        writer.sync().unwrap();
19510        let timings = writer.sync_timings().unwrap();
19511        assert!(
19512            !timings.checkpoint.is_zero(),
19513            "a full checkpoint re-bases the epoch"
19514        );
19515        assert!(
19516            writer.packs_match_checkpoint_table(),
19517            "and records the new table"
19518        );
19519        drop(writer);
19520        drop(reopen_and_read_all(&dir, &wal, 3));
19521        let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(&dir);
19522    }
19523}
